ko.title: 메디케어 공개 등록 기간 12월 7일 마감: 2027년 갱신 전 확인해야 할 사항

segments.src: Medicare's annual open enrollment period runs from October 15 to December 7.
segments.tr: 메디케어의 연간 공개 등록 기간은 10월 15일부터 12월 7일까지입니다.

segments.src: During these weeks, people with Medicare can review their coverage and make changes that take effect on January 1, 2027.
segments.tr: 이 기간 동안 메디케어 가입자는 보장 내용을 검토하고 2027년 1월 1일부로 적용되는 변경 사항을 처리할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Because plans adjust their costs, drug lists and provider networks every year, a plan that worked well in 2026 may not be the best fit next year.
segments.tr: 플랜은 매년 비용, 처방약 목록, 의료진 네트워크를 조정하므로 2026년에 잘 맞았던 플랜이 내년에도 가장 적합할 것이라는 보장은 없습니다.

segments.src: This article is general information, not personal financial, medical or insurance advice.
segments.tr: 이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공을 위한 것이며 개인적인 재정, 의료 또는 보험 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Your own situation, location and plan options will determine what makes sense for you.
segments.tr: 본인의 상황, 지역 및 플랜 옵션에 따라 본인에게 적합한 결정이 달라집니다.

segments.src: ## What You Can Change During Open Enrollment
segments.tr: ## 공개 등록 기간 동안 변경할 수 있는 사항

segments.src: Between October 15 and December 7, people with Medicare can generally:
segments.tr: 10월 15일부터 12월 7일 사이에 메디케어 가입자는 일반적으로 다음을 수행할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Switch from Original Medicare to a Medicare Advantage plan (Part C)**, or the reverse.
segments.tr: - **오리지널 메디케어에서 메디케어 어드밴티지 플랜(파트 C)으로 전환**하거나 그 반대로 전환.

segments.src: - **Switch from one Medicare Advantage plan to another.**
segments.tr: - **하나의 메디케어 어드밴티지 플랜에서 다른 플랜으로 전환.**

segments.src: - **Join, drop or change a Medicare Part D prescription drug plan.**
segments.tr: - **메디케어 파트 D 처방약 플랜 가입, 해지 또는 변경.**

segments.src: If you are happy with your current coverage and it is not changing in ways that matter to you, you do not need to do anything.
segments.tr: 현재 보장 내용에 만족하고 본인에게 중요한 방식으로 변경되지 않는다면 아무것도 할 필요가 없습니다.

segments.src: Most plans renew automatically.
segments.tr: 대부분의 플랜은 자동으로 갱신됩니다.

segments.src: However, automatic renewal also means you accept next year's costs and rules, which is why a review is worthwhile.
segments.tr: 그러나 자동 갱신은 내년의 비용과 규정을 그대로 수용한다는 의미이기도 하므로 검토를 거치는 것이 좋습니다.

segments.src: ## Start With Your Annual Notice of Change
segments.tr: ## 연간 변경 통지서(ANOC)부터 시작하기

segments.src: Medicare Advantage and Part D plans are required to send current members an Annual Notice of Change (ANOC) by the end of September.
segments.tr: 메디케어 어드밴티지 및 파트 D 플랜은 9월 말까지 기존 회원에게 연간 변경 통지서(ANOC)를 발송해야 합니다.

segments.src: Pull it out and read it carefully.
segments.tr: 통지서를 꺼내어 꼼꼼히 읽어보세요.

segments.src: It explains what will be different in 2027, including:
segments.tr: 다음과 같은 2027년의 변경 사항을 설명합니다.

segments.src: - Monthly premiums and deductibles
segments.tr: - 월 보험료 및 본인부담금

segments.src: - Copayments and coinsurance for doctor visits, hospital stays and specialists
segments.tr: - 진료, 입원 및 전문의 진료에 대한 본인부담금 및 공동보험

segments.src: - Changes to the list of covered drugs, known as the formulary
segments.tr: - 처방약 목록(처방집)의 변경 사항

segments.src: - Changes to the pharmacies and providers in the plan's network
segments.tr: - 플랜 네트워크에 속한 약국 및 의료진의 변경 사항

segments.src: - Changes to extra benefits such as dental, vision or hearing
segments.tr: - 치과, 시력 또는 청력 등 추가 혜택의 변경 사항

segments.src: Many people never open this notice.
segments.tr: 많은 사람들이 이 통지서를 열어보지도 않습니다.

segments.src: Reading it is often the quickest way to find out whether your plan is moving in a direction that no longer suits you.
segments.tr: 통지서를 읽는 것은 플랜이 더 이상 본인에게 맞지 않는 방향으로 가고 있는지 확인하는 가장 빠른 방법입니다.

segments.src: ## Six Things to Check Before the Deadline
segments.tr: ## 마감일 전에 확인해야 할 6가지 사항

segments.src: ### 1. Your prescription drugs
Drug coverage is where plan changes most often cause surprises.
segments.tr: 약물 보장은 플랜 변경으로 인해 가장 자주 당황하게 되는 부분입니다.

segments.src: For each medication you take, confirm:
segments.tr: 복용 중인 각 약물에 대해 다음을 확인하세요.

segments.src: - Whether it is still on the plan's formulary
segments.tr: - 플랜의 처방집에 여전히 포함되어 있는지 여부

segments.src: - Which cost tier it falls into, since tiers drive your copay
segments.tr: - 본인부담금에 영향을 미치는 비용 등급 중 어디에 속하는지

segments.src: - Whether new restrictions, such as prior authorization or step therapy, now apply
segments.tr: - 사전 승인이나 단계적 요법과 같은 새로운 제한 사항이 적용되는지 여부

segments.src: - Whether your pharmacy is still in the network, and whether it is a "preferred" pharmacy with lower costs
segments.tr: - 약국이 여전히 네트워크에 포함되어 있는지, 그리고 비용이 더 저렴한 "우대(preferred)" 약국인지 여부

segments.src: Part D also includes an annual cap on what you pay out of pocket for covered drugs, a feature added by recent federal law.
segments.tr: 파트 D에는 최근 연방 법률로 추가된 기능인, 보장되는 약물에 대해 본인이 직접 부담하는 금액에 대한 연간 상한선도 포함되어 있습니다.

segments.src: The cap amount is set and adjusted by the government each year, so check the current figure at Medicare.gov rather than relying on last year's number.
segments.tr: 상한선 금액은 정부에서 매년 설정하고 조정하므로, 작년 숫자에 의존하지 말고 Medicare.gov에서 최신 수치를 확인하세요.

segments.src: ### 2. Your doctors, hospitals and specialists
segments.tr: ### 2. 의사, 병원 및 전문의

segments.src: Original Medicare lets you see any provider who accepts Medicare, nationwide.
segments.tr: 오리지널 메디케어를 이용하면 전국 어디서나 메디케어를 수용하는 의료진을 진료받을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans generally use networks, and some require referrals or prior authorization for certain services.
segments.tr: 메디케어 어드밴티지 플랜은 일반적으로 네트워크를 사용하며, 일부 서비스의 경우 의뢰서나 사전 승인이 필요합니다.

segments.src: Before you renew or switch, look up each of your doctors and any hospital you rely on, and confirm with the provider's office that they will be in the plan's network in 2027.
segments.tr: 갱신하거나 전환하기 전에 각 의사와 신뢰하는 병원을 찾아보고, 해당 의료진 사무실에 2027년 플랜 네트워크에 포함되는지 확인하세요.

segments.src: Networks can change during the year, so asking the office directly is a good safeguard.
segments.tr: 네트워크는 연중 변경될 수 있으므로 사무실에 직접 문의하는 것이 좋은 안전장치입니다.

segments.src: ### 3. The full cost, not just the premium
segments.tr: ### 3. 보험료뿐만 아니라 총비용

segments.src: A low or $0 premium does not tell you what you will actually spend.
segments.tr: 낮거나 0달러인 보험료는 실제로 지출할 비용을 말해주지 않습니다.

segments.src: Compare:
segments.tr: 다음 항목을 비교해 보세요.

segments.src: - Monthly premium (and your Part B premium, which most people still pay)
segments.tr: - 월 보험료 (대부분의 사람들이 여전히 납부하는 파트 B 보험료 포함)

segments.src: - Annual deductible
segments.tr: - 연간 본인부담 면제금

segments.src: - Copays and coinsurance for services you use often
segments.tr: - 자주 이용하는 서비스에 대한 본인부담금 및 공동보험

segments.src: - The plan's maximum out-of-pocket limit for medical services
segments.tr: - 의료 서비스에 대한 플랜의 연간 최대 본인부담 한도

segments.src: - Costs for hospital stays, emergency care and skilled nursing
segments.tr: - 입원, 응급 치료 및 숙련 간호 비용

segments.src: Think about both a typical year and a bad year.
segments.tr: - 평범한 해와 건강이 좋지 않았던 해 모두를 고려해 보세요.

segments.src: A plan with lower premiums but higher cost sharing can cost more if you have a health event.
segments.tr: - 보험료는 낮지만 비용 분담이 높은 플랜은 건강에 문제가 생길 경우 더 많은 비용이 들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ### 4. Plan quality ratings
segments.tr: ### 4. 플랜 품질 평가 등급

segments.src: Medicare rates Advantage and Part D plans on a 5-star scale based on member satisfaction and quality of care.
segments.tr: 메디케어는 회원 만족도와 치료 품질을 바탕으로 5점 만점 척도로 어드밴티지 및 파트 D 플랜을 평가합니다.

segments.src: Ratings are posted in the Medicare Plan Finder.
segments.tr: 평가 등급은 메디케어 플랜 파인더(Medicare Plan Finder)에 게시됩니다.

segments.src: They are not the only factor, but a plan with consistently low ratings deserves a closer look.
segments.tr: 등급이 유일한 요소는 아니지만, 지속적으로 낮은 등급을 받는 플랜은 면밀히 살펴볼 필요가 있습니다.

segments.src: ### 5. Extra benefits, and how they really work
segments.tr: ### 5. 추가 혜택과 실제 작동 방식

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans often advertise extras such as dental, vision, hearing aids, fitness programs, over-the-counter allowances or transportation.
segments.tr: 메디케어 어드밴티지 플랜은 종종 치과, 시력, 보청기, 피트니스 프로그램, 일반의약품 수당 또는 교통편과 같은 추가 혜택을 광고합니다.

segments.src: Read the details: benefits may have dollar caps, limited provider lists, or waiting periods.
segments.tr: 세부 내용을 읽어보세요. 혜택에 금액 상한선, 제한된 의료진 목록 또는 대기 기간이 있을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Compare them against what you would realistically use.
segments.tr: 실제로 사용할 만한 혜택인지 비교해 보세요.

segments.src: ### 6. Your ability to switch back later
segments.tr: ### 6. 나중에 다시 전환할 수 있는 가능성

segments.src: This point matters if you are considering leaving Original Medicare.
segments.tr: 이 점은 오리지널 메디케어를 떠나는 것을 고려하고 있다면 중요합니다.

segments.src: If you buy a Medigap (Medicare Supplement) policy to cover Original Medicare's cost sharing, and later move to Medicare Advantage, you may not be able to get a Medigap policy again without answering health questions.
segments.tr: 오리지널 메디케어의 비용 분담을 보장하기 위해 메디갭(Medigap, 메디케어 보조) 정책을 구매한 후 나중에 메디케어 어드밴티지로 이동하는 경우, 건강 관련 질문에 답하지 않고는 메디갭 정책을 다시 가입하지 못할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: In most states, insurers can base approval or pricing on your health history once your guaranteed-issue window has passed.
segments.tr: 대부분의 주에서 보험사는 보장 발급 창구가 지나간 후 귀하의 건강 기록을 기반으로 승인이나 가격을 책정할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Rules differ by state, so check yours before dropping a supplement.
segments.tr: 규정은 주마다 다르므로 보조 플랜을 해지하기 전에 거주 지역의 규정을 확인하세요.

segments.src: ## Already in Medicare Advantage? You Have a Second Chance
segments.tr: ## 이미 메디케어 어드밴티지를 이용 중이신가요? 두 번째 기회가 있습니다

segments.src: If you are in a Medicare Advantage plan, there is a separate Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period from January 1 to March 31.
segments.tr: 메디케어 어드밴티지 플랜을 이용 중인 경우, 1월 1일부터 3월 31일까지 별도의 메디케어 어드밴티지 공개 등록 기간이 있습니다.

segments.src: During it, you can switch to a different Advantage plan or return to Original Medicare (and join a stand-alone Part D plan).
segments.tr: 이 기간 동안 다른 어드밴티지 플랜으로 전환하거나 오리지널 메디케어로 돌아갈 수 있습니다(단독 파트 D 플랜 가입 가능).

segments.src: You cannot use it to move from Original Medicare into Advantage, and it is limited to one change.
segments.tr: 이 기간을 이용해 오리지널 메디케어에서 어드밴티지로 이동할 수는 없으며, 변경은 한 번으로 제한됩니다.

segments.src: It is a useful safety net, but it is better not to depend on it, since you would start the year in a plan you already suspected was a poor fit.
segments.tr: 유용한 안전망이지만, 애초에 부적합하다고 의심했던 플랜으로 한 해를 시작하게 되므로 이 기간에 의존하지 않는 것이 좋습니다.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Free, Unbiased Help
segments.tr: ## 무료의 편견 없는 도움을 받을 수 있는 곳

segments.src: - **Medicare Plan Finder at Medicare.gov** lets you enter your drugs, pharmacies and ZIP code to compare plans side by side.
segments.tr: - **Medicare.gov의 메디케어 플랜 파인더(Medicare Plan Finder)**를 통해 약물, 약국 및 우편번호를 입력하여 플랜을 나란히 비교할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** connects you with Medicare directly, 24 hours a day.
segments.tr: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)**를 통해 하루 24시간 메디케어와 직접 연결할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIP)** offer free, one-on-one counseling from trained local counselors who do not sell insurance. Find yours at shiphelp.org.
segments.tr: - **주 건강보험 지원 프로그램(SHIP)**은 보험을 판매하지 않는 훈련된 지역 상담원으로부터 무료 일대일 상담을 제공합니다. shiphelp.org에서 거주 지역의 프로그램을 찾아보세요.

segments.src: - **Your "Medicare & You" handbook** summarizes options and rules for the coming year.
segments.tr: - **"Medicare & You" 핸드북**은 다가오는 해의 옵션과 규정을 요약해 줍니다.

segments.src: If you work with an insurance agent or broker, remember that they may be paid by certain plans.
segments.tr: 보험 에이전트나 브로커와 함께 일하는 경우, 그들이 특정 플랜으로부터 수수료를 받을 수 있음을 기억하세요.

segments.src: Ask which plans they do and do not represent, and consider verifying your options in the Plan Finder as well.
segments.tr: 어떤 플랜을 대표하고 어떤 플랜을 대표하지 않는지 물어보고, 플랜 파인더에서도 옵션을 확인해 보는 것을 고려하세요.

segments.src: Be cautious about unsolicited phone calls, texts or door-to-door visits offering Medicare plans, and never share your Medicare number with someone you did not contact yourself.
segments.tr: 메디케어 플랜을 제안하는 원치 않는 전화, 문자 또는 방문 판매에 주의하시고, 본인이 먼저 연락하지 않은 사람에게는 절대 메디케어 번호를 공유하지 마세요.

segments.src: ## A Simple Checklist
segments.tr: ## 간단한 체크리스트

segments.src: 1. Read your Annual Notice of Change.
segments.tr: 1. 연간 변경 통지서를 읽어보세요.

segments.src: 2. List every medication, dose and pharmacy, and test them in the Plan Finder.
segments.tr: 2. 모든 처방약, 복용량, 약국을 나열하고 플랜 파인더에서 테스트해 보세요.

segments.src: 3. Confirm your doctors and hospitals are in-network for 2027.
segments.tr: 3. 의사와 병원이 2027년 네트워크에 포함되는지 확인하세요.

segments.src: 4. Compare total expected costs, not just premiums.
segments.tr: 4. 보험료만이 아니라 예상 총비용을 비교해 보세요.

segments.src: 5. Check star ratings and the details of extra benefits.
segments.tr: 5. 별점 평가와 추가 혜택의 세부 사항을 확인하세요.

segments.src: 6. If leaving Original Medicare, understand your Medigap rights first.
segments.tr: 6. 오리지널 메디케어를 떠나는 경우, 먼저 메디갭 권리를 이해하세요.

segments.src: 7. Make your choice before **December 7**, and confirm it in writing once you enroll.
segments.tr: 7. **12월 7일** 이전에 선택을 마치고, 등록 후 서면으로 확인하세요.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 요약

segments.src: Open enrollment is a short window, and the choices you make carry through the whole year.

zh.title: 红蓝卡 (Medicare) 公开注册期于 12 月 7 日结束：2027 年续保前需检查哪些内容

segments.src: Medicare's annual open enrollment period runs from October 15 to December 7.
segments.tr: 红蓝卡（Medicare）的年度公开注册期为 10 月 15 日至 12 月 7 日。

segments.src: During these weeks, people with Medicare can review their coverage and make changes that take effect on January 1, 2027.
segments.tr: 在此期间，拥有红蓝卡的人士可以审查其保障范围并做出于 2027 年 1 月 1 日生效的更改。

segments.src: Because plans adjust their costs, drug lists and provider networks every year, a plan that worked well in 2026 may not be the best fit next year.
segments.tr: 由于各项计划每年都会调整其费用、药品目录和医疗服务提供者网络，2026 年运行良好的计划明年可能不再是最合适的选择。

segments.src: This article is general information, not personal financial, medical or insurance advice.
segments.tr: 本文仅提供一般性信息，并非个人财务、医疗或保险建议。

segments.src: Your own situation, location and plan options will determine what makes sense for you.
segments.tr: 您自身的具体情况、所在地和计划选项将决定什么对您最合适。

segments.src: ## What You Can Change During Open Enrollment
segments.tr: ## 在公开注册期您可以更改什么

segments.src: Between October 15 and December 7, people with Medicare can generally:
segments.tr: 在 10 月 15 日至 12 月 7 日之间，红蓝卡持有人通常可以：

segments.src: - **Switch from Original Medicare to a Medicare Advantage plan (Part C)**, or the reverse.
segments.tr: - **从原版红蓝卡 (Original Medicare) 切换到红蓝卡优选计划 (Medicare Advantage plan, Part C)**，反之亦然。

segments.src: - **Switch from one Medicare Advantage plan to another.**
segments.tr: - **从一个红蓝卡优选计划切换到另一个计划。**

segments.src: - **Join, drop or change a Medicare Part D prescription drug plan.**
segments.tr: - **加入、退出或更改红蓝卡 D 部分 (Part D) 处方药计划。**

segments.src: If you are happy with your current coverage and it is not changing in ways that matter to you, you do not need to do anything.
segments.tr: 如果您对当前的保障感到满意，且它没有发生对您重要方面的改变，您则无需做任何事情。

segments.src: Most plans renew automatically.
segments.tr: 大多数计划会自动续期。

segments.src: However, automatic renewal also means you accept next year's costs and rules, which is why a review is worthwhile.
segments.tr: 然而，自动续期也意味着您接受了明年的费用和规则，这就是为什么进行审查是值得的。

segments.src: ## Start With Your Annual Notice of Change
segments.tr: ## 从您的年度变更通知开始

segments.src: Medicare Advantage and Part D plans are required to send current members an Annual Notice of Change (ANOC) by the end of September.
segments.tr: 红蓝卡优选计划和 D 部分计划必须在 9 月底之前向现有会员发送年度变更通知 (ANOC)。

segments.src: Pull it out and read it carefully.
segments.tr: 请把它找出来并仔细阅读。

segments.src: It explains what will be different in 2027, including:
segments.tr: 它解释了 2027 年将有哪些不同，包括：

segments.src: - Monthly premiums and deductibles
segments.tr: - 月度保费和免赔额

segments.src: - Copayments and coinsurance for doctor visits, hospital stays and specialists
segments.tr: - 看诊、住院和专科医生的分摊费用和共同保险

segments.src: - Changes to the list of covered drugs, known as the formulary
segments.tr: - 涵盖药品目录（即处方集）的更改

segments.src: - Changes to the pharmacies and providers in the plan's network
segments.tr: - 计划网络内药房和医疗服务提供者的更改

segments.src: - Changes to extra benefits such as dental, vision or hearing
segments.tr: - 牙科、视力或听力等额外福利的更改

segments.src: Many people never open this notice.
segments.tr: 许多人从未打开过这份通知。

segments.src: Reading it is often the quickest way to find out whether your plan is moving in a direction that no longer suits you.
segments.tr: 阅读它通常是了解您的计划是否正朝着不再适合您的方向发展的最快途径。

segments.src: ## Six Things to Check Before the Deadline
segments.tr: ## 截止日期前需要检查的六件事

segments.src: ### 1. Your prescription drugs
segments.tr: ### 1. 您的处方药

segments.src: Drug coverage is where plan changes most often cause surprises.
segments.tr: 药品保障是计划变更最常引起意外的地方。

segments.src: For each medication you take, confirm:
segments.tr: 对于您服用的每种药物，请确认：

segments.src: - Whether it is still on the plan's formulary
segments.tr: - 它是否仍在计划的处方集上

segments.src: - Which cost tier it falls into, since tiers drive your copay
segments.tr: - 它属于哪个费用等级，因为等级决定了您的分摊费用 (copay)

segments.src: - Whether new restrictions, such as prior authorization or step therapy, now apply
segments.tr: - 是否现在适用了新的限制，例如事先授权 (prior authorization) 或分步疗法 (step therapy)

segments.src: - Whether your pharmacy is still in the network, and whether it is a "preferred" pharmacy with lower costs
segments.tr: - 您的药房是否仍在网络内，以及它是否为费用较低的“首选”药房

segments.src: Part D also includes an annual cap on what you pay out of pocket for covered drugs, a feature added by recent federal law.
segments.tr: D 部分还包括对您自付的涵盖药品费用的年度上限，这是近期联邦法律新增的一项功能。

segments.src: The cap amount is set and adjusted by the government each year, so check the current figure at Medicare.gov rather than relying on last year's number.
segments.tr: 上限金额每年由政府设定和调整，因此请在 Medicare.gov 上查看当前的具体数字，而不是依赖去年的数字。

segments.src: ### 2. Your doctors, hospitals and specialists
segments.tr: ### 2. 您的医生、医院和专科医生

segments.src: Original Medicare lets you see any provider who accepts Medicare, nationwide.
segments.tr: 原版红蓝卡允许您在全国范围内看诊任何接受红蓝卡的医疗服务提供者。

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans generally use networks, and some require referrals or prior authorization for certain services.
segments.tr: 红蓝卡优选计划通常使用网络，某些服务需要转诊或事先授权。

segments.src: Before you renew or switch, look up each of your doctors and any hospital you rely on, and confirm with the provider's office that they will be in the plan's network in 2027.
segments.tr: 在您续保或转换之前，请查阅您的每一位医生以及您依赖的任何医院，并与提供者的办公室确认他们在 2027 年是否在该计划的网络内。

segments.src: Networks can change during the year, so asking the office directly is a good safeguard.
segments.tr: 网络在一年中可能会发生变化，因此直接向办公室询问是一个很好的保障措施。

segments.src: ### 3. The full cost, not just the premium
segments.tr: ### 3. 全部费用，而不仅仅是保费

segments.src: A low or $0 premium does not tell you what you will actually spend.
segments.tr: 低保费或 0 美元保费并不代表您实际会花费多少。

segments.src: Compare:
segments.tr: 请比较：

segments.src: - Monthly premium (and your Part B premium, which most people still pay)
segments.tr: - 月度保费（以及大多数人仍需支付的 B 部分保费）

segments.src: - Annual deductible
segments.tr: - 年度免赔额

segments.src: - Copays and coinsurance for services you use often
segments.tr: - 您经常使用的服务的共同支付和共同保险

segments.src: - The plan's maximum out-of-pocket limit for medical services
segments.tr: - 计划针对医疗服务的最高自付额限制

segments.src: - Costs for hospital stays, emergency care and skilled nursing
segments.tr: - 住院、急诊和专业护理的费用

segments.src: Think about both a typical year and a bad year.
segments.tr: 考虑正常的一年和健康状况不好的一年。

segments.src: A plan with lower premiums but higher cost sharing can cost more if you have a health event.
segments.tr: 如果您遇到健康事件，保费较低但费用分摊较高的计划最终可能会花费更多。

segments.src: ### 4. Plan quality ratings
segments.tr: ### 4. 计划质量评级

segments.src: Medicare rates Advantage and Part D plans on a 5-star scale based on member satisfaction and quality of care.
segments.tr: 红蓝卡根据会员满意度和护理质量，以 5 星评级对优选计划和 D 部分计划进行评定。

segments.src: Ratings are posted in the Medicare Plan Finder.
segments.tr: 评级公布在红蓝卡计划查找器 (Medicare Plan Finder) 中。

segments.src: They are not the only factor, but a plan with consistently low ratings deserves a closer look.
segments.tr: 它们并非唯一的决定因素，但评级持续较低的计划值得您仔细研究。

segments.src: ### 5. Extra benefits, and how they really work
segments.tr: ### 5. 额外福利及其真正运作方式

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans often advertise extras such as dental, vision, hearing aids, fitness programs, over-the-counter allowances or transportation.
segments.tr: 红蓝卡优选计划通常会宣传牙科、视力、助听器、健身计划、非处方药津贴或交通等额外服务。

segments.src: Read the details: benefits may have dollar caps, limited provider lists, or waiting periods.
segments.tr: 请阅读详细信息：福利可能有金额上限、有限的提供者名单或等待期。

segments.src: Compare them against what you would realistically use.
segments.tr: 将它们与您实际会使用的功能进行对比。

segments.src: ### 6. Your ability to switch back later
segments.tr: ### 6. 稍后切回原计划的能力

segments.src: This point matters if you are considering leaving Original Medicare.
segments.tr: 如果您正在考虑离开原版红蓝卡，这一点就很重要。

segments.src: If you buy a Medigap (Medicare Supplement) policy to cover Original Medicare's cost sharing, and later move to Medicare Advantage, you may not be able to get a Medigap policy again without answering health questions.
segments.tr: 如果您购买了 Medigap（红蓝卡补充保险）来承担原版红蓝卡的费用分摊，后来又转到了红蓝卡优选计划，您以后可能无法在不回答健康问题的情况下再次购买 Medigap 政策。

segments.src: In most states, insurers can base approval or pricing on your health history once your guaranteed-issue window has passed.
segments.tr: 在大多数州，一旦您的保证承保期 (guaranteed-issue window) 过去，保险公司就可以根据您的健康史来决定批准与否或定价。

segments.src: Rules differ by state, so check yours before dropping a supplement.
segments.tr: 各州的规则有所不同，因此在放弃补充保险之前请先查看您所在州的规定。

segments.src: ## Already in Medicare Advantage? You Have a Second Chance
segments.tr: ## 已经参加了红蓝卡优选计划？您还有第二次机会

segments.src: If you are in a Medicare Advantage plan, there is a separate Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period from January 1 to March 31.
segments.tr: 如果您加入了红蓝卡优选计划，则在 1 月 1 日至 3 月 31 日期间还有一个单独的红蓝卡优选计划公开注册期。

segments.src: During it, you can switch to a different Advantage plan or return to Original Medicare (and join a stand-alone Part D plan).
segments.tr: 在此期间，您可以切换到不同的优选计划或返回原版红蓝卡（并加入一个独立的 D 部分计划）。

segments.src: You cannot use it to move from Original Medicare into Advantage, and it is limited to one change.
segments.tr: 您不能利用此机会从原版红蓝卡转入优选计划，且此更改限制为一次。

segments.src: It is a useful safety net, but it is better not to depend on it, since you would start the year in a plan you already suspected was a poor fit.
segments.tr: 这是一个有用的安全网，但最好不要依赖它，因为这样会导致您在一开始就处于一个您已经怀疑不太适合的计划中。

segments.src: ## Where to Get Free, Unbiased Help
segments.tr: ## 在哪里获得免费、公正的帮助

segments.src: - **Medicare Plan Finder at Medicare.gov** lets you enter your drugs, pharmacies and ZIP code to compare plans side by side.
segments.tr: - **Medicare.gov 上的红蓝卡计划查找器**允许您输入您的药物、药房和邮政编码，以并排比较不同的计划。

segments.src: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** connects you with Medicare directly, 24 hours a day.
segments.tr: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** 全天候直接为您连接红蓝卡客服。

segments.src: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIP)** offer free, one-on-one counseling from trained local counselors who do not sell insurance. Find yours at shiphelp.org.
segments.tr: - **州医疗保险援助计划 (SHIP)** 提供来自训练有素的当地顾问的免费、一对一咨询，这些顾问不销售保险。请在 shiphelp.org 上寻找您所在州的机构。

segments.src: - **Your "Medicare & You" handbook** summarizes options and rules for the coming year.
segments.tr: - **您的“Medicare & You”手册**总结了来年的选项和规则。

segments.src: If you work with an insurance agent or broker, remember that they may be paid by certain plans.
segments.tr: 如果您与保险代理人或经纪人合作，请记住他们可能会从某些计划中获得报酬。

segments.src: Ask which plans they do and do not represent, and consider verifying your options in the Plan Finder as well.
segments.tr: 询问他们代理和不代理哪些计划，并考虑同时在计划查找器中验证您的选项。

segments.src: Be cautious about unsolicited phone calls, texts or door-to-door visits offering Medicare plans, and never share your Medicare number with someone you did not contact yourself.
segments.tr: 对提供红蓝卡计划的主动来电、短信或上门访问保持谨慎，切勿将您的红蓝卡号码透露给您未曾主动联系过的人。

segments.src: ## A Simple Checklist
segments.tr: ## 简单的检查清单

segments.src: 1. Read your Annual Notice of Change.
segments.tr: 1. 阅读您的年度变更通知。

segments.src: 2. List every medication, dose and pharmacy, and test them in the Plan Finder.
segments.tr: 2. 列出每种药物、剂量和药房，并在计划查找器中进行测试。

segments.src: 3. Confirm your doctors and hospitals are in-network for 2027.
segments.tr: 3. 确认您的医生和医院在 2027 年的网络内。

segments.src: 4. Compare total expected costs, not just premiums.
segments.tr: 4. 比较预期的总费用，而不仅仅是保费。

segments.src: 5. Check star ratings and the details of extra benefits.
segments.tr: 5. 检查星级评级以及额外福利的详细信息。

segments.src: 6. If leaving Original Medicare, understand your Medigap rights first.
segments.tr: 6. 如果要离开原版红蓝卡，请先了解您的 Medigap 权利。

segments.src: 7. Make your choice before **December 7**, and confirm it in writing once you enroll.
segments.tr: 7. 在 **12 月 7 日**之前做出选择，并在注册后以书面形式予以确认。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: Open enrollment is a short window, and the choices you make carry through the whole year.
segments.tr: 公开注册期是一个很短的窗口，您做出的选择将贯穿全年。

segments.src: Spending an hour comparing options now can help you avoid unexpected bills and gaps in coverage in 2027.
segments.tr: 现在花一个小时比较选项，可以帮助您避免在 2027 年产生意外账单和保障范围的漏洞。

segments.src: Whether you decide to keep your current plan or change it, make it a deliberate choice rather than a default.
segments.tr: 无论您决定保留当前计划还是更改计划，这都应该是一个经过深思熟虑的选择，而不是默认结果。

segments.src: *Plan details, benefit amounts and deadlines can change.
segments.tr: *计划详情、福利金额和截止日期可能会发生变化。

segments.src: Always confirm current information with Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE before making enrollment decisions.*
segments.tr: *在做出注册决定之前，请务必通过 Medicare.gov 或 1-800-MEDICARE 确认当前信息。*

es.title: La inscripción abierta de Medicare finaliza el 7 de diciembre: qué revisar antes de renovar para 2027

segments.src: Medicare's annual open enrollment period runs from October 15 to December 7.
segments.tr: El período anual de inscripción abierta de Medicare se extiende del 15 de octubre al 7 de diciembre.

segments.src: During these weeks, people with Medicare can review their coverage and make changes that take effect on January 1, 2027.
segments.tr: Durante estas semanas, las personas con Medicare pueden revisar su cobertura y hacer cambios que entrarán en vigor el 1 de enero de 2027.

segments.src: Because plans adjust their costs, drug lists and provider networks every year, a plan that worked well in 2026 may not be the best fit next year.
segments.tr: Debido a que los planes ajustan sus costos, listas de medicamentos y redes de proveedores cada año, un plan que funcionó bien en 2026 puede no ser la mejor opción el próximo año.

segments.src: This article is general information, not personal financial, medical or insurance advice.

segments.tr: Su propia situación, ubicación y las opciones de planes determinarán qué tiene sentido para usted.

segments.src: ## What You Can Change During Open Enrollment
segments.tr: ## Qué puede cambiar durante la inscripción abierta

segments.src: Between October 15 and December 7, people with Medicare can generally:
segments.tr: Entre el 15 de octubre y el 7 de diciembre, las personas con Medicare generalmente pueden:

segments.src: - **Switch from Original Medicare to a Medicare Advantage plan (Part C)**, or the reverse.
segments.tr: - **Cambiar de Medicare Original a un plan Medicare Advantage (Parte C)**, o viceversa.

segments.src: - **Switch from one Medicare Advantage plan to another.**
segments.tr: - **Cambiar de un plan Medicare Advantage a otro.**

segments.src: - **Join, drop or change a Medicare Part D prescription drug plan.**
segments.tr: - **Inscribirse, cancelar o cambiar un plan de medicamentos recetados de la Parte D de Medicare.**

segments.src: If you are happy with your current coverage and it is not changing in ways that matter to you, you do not need to do anything.
segments.tr: Si está satisfecho con su cobertura actual y esta no cambia de maneras que le importen, no necesita hacer nada.

segments.src: Most plans renew automatically.
segments.tr: La mayoría de los planes se renuevan automáticamente.

segments.src: However, automatic renewal also means you accept next year's costs and rules, which is why a review is worthwhile.
segments.tr: Sin embargo, la renovación automática también significa que acepta los costos y reglas del próximo año, por lo que vale la pena hacer una revisión.

segments.src: ## Start With Your Annual Notice of Change
segments.tr: ## Comience con su Aviso Anual de Cambio

segments.src: Medicare Advantage and Part D plans are required to send current members an Annual Notice of Change (ANOC) by the end of September.
segments.tr: Los planes Medicare Advantage y de la Parte D están obligados a enviar a los miembros actualizados un Aviso Anual de Cambio (ANOC, por sus siglas en inglés) a finales de septiembre.

segments.src: Pull it out and read it carefully.
segments.tr: Sáquelo y léalo detenidamente.

segments.src: It explains what will be different in 2027, including:
segments.tr: Explica qué será diferente en 2027, incluyendo:

segments.src: - Monthly premiums and deductibles
segments.tr: - Primas mensuales y deducibles

segments.src: - Copayments and coinsurance for doctor visits, hospital stays and specialists
segments.tr: - Copagos y coseguros para visitas al médico, estadías en el hospital y especialistas

segments.src: - Changes to the list of covered drugs, known as the formulary
segments.tr: - Cambios en la lista de medicamentos cubiertos, conocida como el formulario

segments.src: - Changes to the pharmacies and providers in the plan's network
segments.tr: - Cambios en las farmacias y proveedores de la red del plan

segments.src: - Changes to extra benefits such as dental, vision or hearing
segments.tr: - Cambios en beneficios adicionales como dental, visión o audición

segments.src: Many people never open this notice.
segments.tr: Muchas personas nunca abren este aviso.

segments.src: Reading it is often the quickest way to find out whether your plan is moving in a direction that no longer suits you.

segments.tr: - En qué nivel de costos se encuentra, ya que los niveles determinan su copago

segments.tr: - Si se aplican nuevas restricciones, como autorización previa o terapia escalonada

segments.tr: - Si su farmacia sigue en la red y si es una farmacia "preferida" con costos más bajos

segments.src: Part D also includes an annual cap on what you pay out of pocket for covered drugs, a feature added by recent federal law.
segments.tr: La Parte D también incluye un límite anual en lo que paga de su bolsillo por los medicamentos cubiertos, una característica agregada por una ley federal reciente.

segments.src: The cap amount is set and adjusted by the government each year, so check the current figure at Medicare.gov rather than relying on last year's number.
segments.tr: El monto del límite lo establece y ajusta el gobierno cada año, así que consulte la cifra actual en Medicare.gov en lugar de confiar en el número del año pasado.

segments.tr: 6. Si deja Medicare Original, comprenda primero sus derechos sobre Medigap.

segments.src: 7. Make your choice before **December 7**, and confirm it in writing once you enroll.
segments.tr: 7. Tome su decisión antes del **7 de diciembre** y confírmela por escrito una vez que se inscriba.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En resumen

segments.src: Open enrollment is a short window, and the choices you make carry through the whole year.
segments.tr: La inscripción abierta es un período corto y las elecciones que haga se mantendrán durante todo el año.

segments.src: Spending an hour comparing options now can help you avoid unexpected bills and gaps in coverage in 2027.
segments.tr: Dedicar una hora a comparar opciones ahora puede ayudarle a evitar facturas inesperadas y brechas en la cobertura en 2027.

segments.src: Whether you decide to keep your current plan or change it, make it a deliberate choice rather than a default.
segments.tr: Ya sea que decida mantener su plan actual o cambiarlo, que sea una elección deliberada y no por defecto.

segments.src: *Plan details, benefit amounts and deadlines can change.
segments.tr: *Los detalles del plan, los montos de los beneficios y los plazos pueden cambiar.

segments.src: Always confirm current information with Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE before making enrollment decisions.*
segments.tr: Siempre confirme la información actual con Medicare.gov o llamando al 1-800-MEDICARE antes de tomar decisiones de inscripción.*

ar.title: انتهاء فترة التسجيل المفتوح في برنامج Medicare في 7 ديسمبر: ما الذي يجب التحقق منه قبل تجديد اشتراكك لعام 2027

segments.src: Medicare's annual open enrollment period runs from October 15 to December 7.
segments.tr: تبدأ فترة التسجيل المفتوح السنوية لبرنامج Medicare من 15 أكتوبر إلى 7 ديسمبر.

segments.src: During these weeks, people with Medicare can review their coverage and make changes that take effect on January 1, 2027.
segments.tr: خلال هذه الأسابيع، يمكن للأشخاص المشمولين ببرنامج Medicare مراجعة تغطيتهم وإجراء تغييرات تصبح سارية المفعول في 1 يناير 2027.

segments.src: Because plans adjust their costs, drug lists and provider networks every year, a plan that worked well in 2026 may not be the best fit next year.
segments.tr: نظرًا لأن الخطط تقوم بتعديل تكاليفها وقوائم الأدوية شبكات مقدمي الخدمة كل عام، فإن الخطة التي كانت مناسبة جيدًا في 2026 قد لا تكون الخيار الأمثل للعام المقبل.

segments.src: This article is general information, not personal financial, medical or insurance advice.
segments.tr: تعتبر هذه المقالة معلومات عامة وليست نصيحة مالية أو طبية أو تأمينية شخصية.

segments.src: Your own situation, location and plan options will determine what makes sense for you.
segments.tr: ستحدد وضعك الخاص وموقعك وخيارات خطتك ما هو منطقي بالنسبة لك.

segments.src: ## What You Can Change During Open Enrollment
segments.tr: ## ما يمكنك تغييره خلال فترة التسجيل المفتوح

segments.src: Between October 15 and December 7, people with Medicare can generally:
segments.tr: بين 15 أكتوبر و7 ديسمبر، يمكن للأشخاص المشتركين في Medicare بشكل عام:

segments.src: - **Switch from Original Medicare to a Medicare Advantage plan (Part C)**, or the reverse.
segments.tr: - **التحول من برنامج Medicare الأصلي إلى خطة Medicare Advantage (الجزء C)**، أو العكس.

segments.src: - **Switch from one Medicare Advantage plan to another.**
segments.tr: - **التحول من خطة Medicare Advantage إلى أخرى.**

segments.src: - **Join, drop or change a Medicare Part D prescription drug plan.**
segments.tr: - **الاشتراك في خطة الأدوية الموصوفة ضمن الجزء D من Medicare، أو إلغاؤها، أو تغييرها.**

segments.src: If you are happy with your current coverage and it is not changing in ways that matter to you, you do not need to do anything.
segments.tr: إذا كنت راضيًا عن تغطيتك الحالية ولم تكن تتغير بطرق تهمك، فلا داعي لفعل أي شيء.

segments.src: Most plans renew automatically.
segments.tr: تتم2 تجديد معظم الخطط تلقائيًا.

segments.src: However, automatic renewal also means you accept next year's costs and rules, which is why a review is worthwhile.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، فإن التجديد التلقائي يعني أيضًا قبولك لتكاليف وقواعد العام المقبل، وهذا هو سبب أهمية إجراء مراجعة.

segments.src: ## Start With Your Annual Notice of Change
segments.tr: ## ابدأ بإشعار التغيير السنوية الخاص بك

segments.src: Medicare Advantage and Part D plans are required to send current members an Annual Notice of Change (ANOC) by the end of September.
segments.tr: تُلزم خطط Medicare Advantage والجزء D بإرسال إشعار التغيير السنوي (ANOC) للأعضاء الحاليين بحلول نهاية سبتمبر.

segments.src: Pull it out and read it carefully.
segments.tr: قم بإحضاره وقراءته بعناية.

segments.src: It explains what will be different in 2027, including:
segments.tr: إنه يوضح ما سيكون مختلفًا في عام 2027، بما في ذلك:

segments.src: - Monthly premiums and deductibles
segments.tr: - الأقساط الشهرية والمخصومات

segments.src: - Copayments and coinsurance for doctor visits, hospital stays and specialists
segments.tr: - المدفوعات المشتركة والتأمين المشترك لزيارات الطبيب، والإقامات في المستشفى، والأخصائيين

segments.src: - Changes to the list of covered drugs, known as the formulary
segments.tr: - التغييرات في قائمة الأدوية المشمولة، والمعروفة باسم قائمة الأدوية (formulary)

segments.src: - Changes to the pharmacies and providers in the plan's network
segments.tr: - التغييرات في الصيدليات ومقدمي الخدمات في شبكة الخطة

segments.src: - Changes to extra benefits such as dental, vision or hearing
segments.tr: - التغييرات في المزايا الإضافية مثل طب الأسنان، أو الرؤية، أو السمع

segments.src: Many people never open this notice.
segments.tr: لا يفتح الكثير من الناس هذا الإشعار أبدًا.

segments.src: Reading it is often the quickest way to find out whether your plan is moving in a direction that no longer suits you.
segments.tr: تعتبر قراءته غالبًا أسرع طريقة لمعرفة ما إذا كانت خطتك تتحرك في اتجاه لم يعد يناسبك.

segments.src: ## Six Things to Check Before the Deadline
segments.tr: ## ستة أمور يجب التحقق منها قبل الموعد النهائي

segments.src: ### 1. Your prescription drugs
segments.tr: ### 1. أدوية الوصفات الطبية الخاصة بك

segments.src: Drug coverage is where plan changes most often cause surprises.
segments.tr: تعد تغطية الأدوية هي المجال الذي تتسبب فيه تغييرات الخطط في حدوث مفاجآت في أغلب الأحيان.

segments.src: For each medication you take, confirm:
segments.tr: لكل دواء تتناوله، تأكد من:

segments.src: - Whether it is still on the plan's formulary
segments.tr: - ما إذا كان لا يزال ضمن قائمة الأدوية الخاصة بالخطة

segments.src: - Which cost tier it falls into, since tiers drive your copay
segments.tr: - مستوى التكلفة الذي يقع ضمنه، حيث أن المستويات تحدد الدفع المشترك الخاص بك

segments.src: - Whether new restrictions, such as prior authorization or step therapy, now apply
segments.tr: - ما إذا كانت القيود الجديدة، مثل التفويض المسبق أو العلاج التدريجي، تنطبق الآن

segments.src: - Whether your pharmacy is still in the network, and whether it is a "preferred" pharmacy with lower costs
segments.tr: - ما إذا كانت صيدليتك لا تزال ضمن الشبكة، وما إذا كانت صيدلية "مفضلة" بتكاليف أقل

segments.src: Part D also includes an annual cap on what you pay out of pocket for covered drugs, a feature added by recent federal law.
segments.tr: يتضمن الجزء D أيضًا حدًا أقصى سنويًا لما تدفعه من جيبك مقابل الأدوية المشمولة، وهي ميزة أضافها قانون فدرالي حديث.

segments.src: The cap amount is set and adjusted by the government each year, so check the current figure at Medicare.gov rather than relying on last year's number.
segments.tr: يتم تحديد مبلغ الحد الأقصى وتعديله من قبل الحكومة كل عام، لذا تحقق من الرقم الحالي على موقع Medicare.gov بدلاً من الاعتماد على رقم العام الماضي.

segments.src: ### 2. Your doctors, hospitals and specialists
segments.tr: ### 2. أباؤك، ومستشفياتك، والأخصائيون

segments.src: Original Medicare lets you see any provider who accepts Medicare, nationwide.
segments.tr: يتيح لك برنامج Medicare الأصلي رؤية أي مقدم خدمة يقبل برنامج Medicare على مستوى الدولة.

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans generally use networks, and some require referrals or prior authorization for certain services.
segments.tr: تستخدم خطط Medicare Advantage عمومًا شبكات، ويتطلب بعضها إحالات أو تفويضًا مسبقًا لخدمات معينّة.

segments.src: Before you renew or switch, look up each of your doctors and any hospital you rely on, and confirm with the provider's office that they will be in the plan's network in 2027.
segments.tr: قبل التجديد أو التبديل، ابحث عن كل طبيب من أطبائك وأي مستشفى تعتمد عليه، وتأكد مع مكتب مقدم الخدمة من أنه سيكون ضمن شبكة الخطة في عام 2027.

segments.src: Networks can change during the year, so asking the office directly is a good safeguard.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تتغير الشبكات خلال العام، لذا فإن السؤال المباشر للمكتب يعتبر وسيلة حماية جيدة.

segments.src: ### 3. The full cost, not just the premium
segments.tr: ### 3. التكلفة الإجمالية، وليست القسط وحده

segments.src: A low or $0 premium does not tell you what you will actually spend.
segments.tr: القسط المنخفض أو بقيمة 0 دولار لا يوضح ما ستنفقه بالفعل.

segments.src: Compare:
segments.tr: قارن بين:

segments.src: - Monthly premium (and your Part B premium, which most people still pay)
segments.tr: - القسط الشهري (وقسط الجزء B الخاص بك، الذي لا يزال معظم الناس يدفعونه)

segments.src: - Annual deductible
segments.tr: - المخصوم السنوي

segments.src: - Copays and coinsurance for services you use often
segments.tr: - المدفوعات المشتركة والتأمين المشترك للخدمات التي تستخدمها بشكل متكرر

segments.src: - The plan's maximum out-of-pocket limit for medical services
segments.tr: - الحد الأقصى لما يتم دفعه من الجيب للخدمات الطبية في الخطة

segments.src: - Costs for hospital stays, emergency care and skilled nursing
segments.tr: - تكاليف الإقامات في المستشفيات، والرعاية الطارئة، والتمريض الماهر

segments.src: Think about both a typical year and a bad year.
segments.tr: فكر في كل من العام النموذجي العام السيئ.

segments.src: A plan with lower premiums but higher cost sharing can cost more if you have a health event.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تكون تكلفة خطة ذات أقساط أقل ولكن بتكلفة مشتركة أعلى أكبر إذا واجهتك حالة صحية.

segments.src: ### 4. Plan quality ratings
segments.tr: ### 4. تقييمات جودة الخطة

segments.src: Medicare rates Advantage and Part D plans on a 5-star scale based on member satisfaction and quality of care.
segments.tr: يُقيم Medicare خطط Advantage والجزء D على مقياس من 5 نجوم بناءً على رضا الأعضاء وجودة الرعاية.

segments.src: Ratings are posted in the Medicare Plan Finder.
segments.tr: يتم نشر التقييمات في أداة البحث عن خطط Medicare.

segments.src: They are not the only factor, but a plan with consistently low ratings deserves a closer look.
segments.tr: وهي ليست العامل الوحيد، ولكن الخطة ذات التقييمات المنخفضة باستمرار تستحق نظرة فاحصة.

segments.src: ### 5. Extra benefits, and how they really work
segments.tr: ### 5. المزايا الإضافية، وكيف تعمل حقًا

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans often advertise extras such as dental, vision, hearing aids, fitness programs, over-the-counter allowances or transportation.
segments.tr: غالبًا ما تعلن خطط Medicare Advantage عن ميزات إضافية مثل طب الأسنان، أو الرؤية، أو سماعات الأذن، أو برامج اللياقة البدنية، أو مخصصات الأدوية التي لا تتطلب وصفة طبية، أو النقل.

segments.src: Read the details: benefits may have dollar caps, limited provider lists, or waiting periods.
segments.tr: اقرأ التفاصيل: قد يكون للمزايا حدود مالية، أو قوائم مقدمي خدمات محدودة، أو فترات انتظار.

segments.src: Compare them against what you would realistically use.
segments.tr: قارنها بما قد تستخدمه واقعيًا.

segments.src: ### 6. Your ability to switch back later
segments.tr: ### 6. قدرتك على التبديل لاحقًا

segments.src: This point matters if you are considering leaving Original Medicare.
segments.tr: هذه النقطة تهمك إذا كنت تفكر في ترك Medicare الأصلي.

segments.src: If you buy a Medigap (Medicare Supplement) policy to cover Original Medicare's cost sharing, and later move to Medicare Advantage, you may not be able to get a Medigap policy again without answering health questions.
segments.tr: إذا اشتريت بوليصة Medigap (ملحق Medicare) لتغطية تكلفة مشاركة Medicare الأصلي، ثم انتقلت لاحقًا إلى Medicare Advantage، فقد لا تتمكن من الحصول على بوليصة Medigap مرة أخرى دون الإجابة على أسئلة صحية.

segments.src: In most states, insurers can base approval or pricing on your health history once your guaranteed-issue window has passed.
segments.tr: في معظم الولايات، يمكن لشركات التأمين أن تبني الموافقة أو التسعير على تاريخك الصحي بمجرد مرور نافذة الإصدار المضمون الخاصة بك.

segments.src: Rules differ by state, so check yours before dropping a supplement.
segments.tr: تختلف القواعد حسب الولاية، لذا تحقق من ولايتك قبل التخلي عن الملحق.

segments.src: ## Already in Medicare Advantage? You Have a Second Chance
segments.tr: ## هل أنت مشترك بالفعل في Medicare Advantage؟ لديك فرصة ثانية

segments.src: If you are in a Medicare Advantage plan, there is a separate Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period from January 1 to March 31.
segments.tr: إذا كنت مشتركًا في خطة Medicare Advantage، فهناك فترة تسجيل مفتوح منفصلة لـ Medicare Advantage من 1 يناير إلى 31 مارس.

segments.src: During it, you can switch to a different Advantage plan or return to Original Medicare (and join a stand-alone Part D plan).
segments.tr: خلالها، يمكنك التبديل إلى خطة Advantage مختلفة أو العودة إلى Medicare الأصلي (والانضمام إلى خطة جزء D مستقلة).

segments.src: You cannot use it to move from Original Medicare into Advantage, and it is limited to one change.
segments.tr: لا يمكنك استخدامها للانتقال من Medicare الأصلي إلى Advantage، وهي تقتصر على تغيير واحد.

segments.src: It is a useful safety net, but it is better not to depend on it, since you would start the year in a plan you already suspected was a poor fit.
segments.tr: إنها شبكة أمان مفيدة، ولكن من الأفضل عدم الاعتماد عليها، حيث ستSبدأ العام في خطة كنت تشك مسبقًا في أنها غير مناسبة.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Free, Unbiased Help
segments.tr: ## أين تحصل على مساعدة مجانية وغير متحيزة

segments.src: - **Medicare Plan Finder at Medicare.gov** lets you enter your drugs, pharmacies and ZIP code to compare plans side by side.
segments.tr: - **يتيح لك أداة البحث عن خطط Medicare على Medicare.gov** إدخال أدويتك وصيدلياتك والرمز البريدي لمقارنة الخطط جنبًا إلى جنب.

segments.src: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** connects you with Medicare directly, 24 hours a day.
segments.tr: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** يوصلك بـ Medicare مباشرة، 24 ساعة في اليوم.

segments.src: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIP)** offer free, one-on-one counseling from trained local counselors who do not sell insurance. Find yours at shiphelp.org.
segments.tr: - **برامج المساعدة في التأمين الصحي الحكومي (SHIP)** توفر استشارات مجانية فردية من مستشارين محليين مدربين لا يبيعون التأمين. ابحث عن برنامج ولايتك على shiphelp.org.

segments.src: - **Your "Medicare & You" handbook** summarizes options and rules for the coming year.
segments.tr: - **كتيبك "Medicare & You"** يلخص الخيارات والقواعد للعام القادم.

segments.src: If you work with an insurance agent or broker, remember that they may be paid by certain plans.
segments.tr: إذا كنت تتعامل مع وكيل تأمين أو وسيط، تذكر أنه قد يتم دفع أجره من قِبل خطط معينة.

segments.src: Ask which plans they do and do not represent, and consider verifying your options in the Plan Finder as well.
segments.tr: اسأل عن الخطط التي يمثلها والتي لا يمثلها، وفكر في التحقق من خياراتك في أداة البحث عن الخطط أيضًا.

segments.src: Be cautious about unsolicited phone calls, texts or door-to-door visits offering Medicare plans, and never share your Medicare number with someone you did not contact yourself.
segments.tr: كن حذرًا بشأن المكالمات الهاتفية غيرSolicited، أو الرسائل النصية، أو زيارات المنازل التي تقدم خطط Medicare، ولا تشارك رقم Medicare الخاص بك أبدًا مع شخص لم تتصل به بنفسك.

segments.src: ## A Simple Checklist
segments.tr: ## قائمة تحقق بسيطة

segments.src: 1. Read your Annual Notice of Change.
segments.tr: 1. اقرأ إشعار التغيير السنوي الخاص بك.

segments.src: 2. List every medication, dose and pharmacy, and test them in the Plan Finder.
segments.tr: 2. اذكر كل دواء، وجرعة، وصيدلية، واختبرها في أداة البحث عن الخطط.

segments.src: 3. Confirm your doctors and hospitals are in-network for 2027.
segments.tr: 3. تأكد من أن أطباءك ومستشفياتك ضمن شبكة خطة 2027.

segments.src: 4. Compare total expected costs, not just premiums.
segments.tr: 4. قارن إجمالي التكاليف المتوقعة، وليس فقط الأقساط.

segments.src: 5. Check star ratings and the details of extra benefits.
segments.tr: 5. تحقق من تقييمات النجوم وتفاصيل المزايا الإضافية.

segments.src: 6. If leaving Original Medicare, understand your Medigap rights first.
segments.tr: 6. إذا كنت ستترك Medicare الأصلي، فافهم حقوق Medigap الخاصة بك أولاً.

segments.src: 7. Make your choice before **December 7**, and confirm it in writing once you enroll.
segments.tr: 7. اتخذ اختيارك قبل **7 ديسمبر**، وتأكد منه كتابيًا بمجرد التسجيل.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: Open enrollment is a short window, and the choices you make carry through the whole year.
segments.tr: فترة التسجيل المفتوح هي نافذة قصيرة، والخيارات التي تتخذها تستمر طوال العام.

segments.src: Spending an hour comparing options now can help you avoid unexpected bills and gaps in coverage in 2027.
segments.tr: إن قضاء ساعة في مقارنة الخيارات الآن يمكن أن يساعدك في تجنب الفواتير غير المتوقعة والثغرات في التغطية في عام 2027.

segments.src: Whether you decide to keep your current plan or change it, make it a deliberate choice rather than a default.
segments.tr: سواء قررت الاحتفاظ بخطتك الحالية أو تغييرها، اجعلها خيارًا مقصودًا بدلاً من الاكتفاء بالوضع الافتراضي.

segments.src: *Plan details, benefit amounts and deadlines can change.
segments.tr: *قد تتغير تفاصيل الخطط، ومبالغ المزايا، والمواعيد النهائية.

segments.src: Always confirm current information with Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE before making enrollment decisions.*
segments.tr: دائمًا ما يجب تأكيد المعلومات الحالية مع موقع Medicare.gov أو الاتصال بـ 1-800-MEDICARE قبل اتخاذ قرارات التسجيل.*

fr.title: La période d'inscription ouverte de Medicare se termine le 7 décembre : ce qu'il faut vérifier avant de renouveler pour 2027

segments.src: Medicare's annual open enrollment period runs from October 15 to December 7.
segments.tr: La période annuelle d'inscription ouverte de Medicare se déroule du 15 octobre au 7 décembre.

segments.src: During these weeks, people with Medicare can review their coverage and make changes that take effect on January 1, 2027.
segments.tr: Pendant ces semaines, les bénéficiaires de Medicare peuvent examiner leur couverture et apporter des modifications qui prennent effet le 1er janvier 2027.

segments.src: ## What You Can Change During Open Enrollment
segments.tr: ## Ce que vous pouvez modifier pendant la période d'inscription ouverte

segments.src: Between October 15 and December 7, people with Medicare can generally:
segments.tr: Entre le 15 octobre et le 7 décembre, les bénéficiaires de Medicare peuvent généralement :

segments.src: - **Switch from Original Medicare to a Medicare Advantage plan (Part C)**, or the reverse.
segments.tr: - **Passer de Medicare d'origine à un plan Medicare Advantage (Partie C)**, ou inversement.

segments.src: - **Switch from one Medicare Advantage plan to another.**
segments.tr: - **Passer d'un plan Medicare Advantage à un autre.**

segments.src: - **Join, drop or change a Medicare Part D prescription drug plan.**
segments.tr: - **Souscrire, résilier ou modifier un plan de médicaments sur ordonnance Medicare Partie D.**

segments.src: If you are happy with your current coverage and it is not changing in ways that matter to you, you do not need to do anything.
segments.tr: Si vous êtes satisfait de votre couverture actuelle et qu'elle ne change pas de manière significative pour vous, vous n'avez rien à faire.

segments.src: Most plans renew automatically.
segments.tr: La plupart des régimes se renouvellent automatiquement.

segments.src: However, automatic renewal also means you accept next year's costs and rules, which is why a review is worthwhile.
segments.tr: Cependant, le renouvellement automatique signifie également que vous acceptez les coûts et les règles de l'année prochaine, c'est pourquoi un examen est utile.

segments.src: ## Start With Your Annual Notice of Change
segments.tr: ## Commencez par votre avis annuel de changement

segments.src: Medicare Advantage and Part D plans are required to send current members an Annual Notice of Change (ANOC) by the end of September.
segments.tr: Les plans Medicare Advantage et de la Partie D sont tenus d'envoyer aux membres actuels un avis annuel de changement (ANOC) d'ici la fin septembre.

segments.src: Pull it out and read it carefully.
segments.tr: Sortez-le et lisez-le attentivement.

segments.src: It explains what will be different in 2027, including:
segments.tr: Il explique ce qui changera en 2027, notamment :

segments.src: - Monthly premiums and deductibles
segments.tr: - Les primes mensuelles et les franchises

segments.src: - Copayments and coinsurance for doctor visits, hospital stays and specialists
segments.tr: - Les co-paiements et la coassurance pour les visites chez le médecin, les séjours à l'hôpital et les spécialistes

segments.src: - Changes to the list of covered drugs, known as the formulary
segments.tr: - Les modifications apportées à la liste des médicaments couverts, connue sous le nom de formulaire

segments.src: - Changes to the pharmacies and providers in the plan's network
segments.tr: - Les modifications apportées aux pharmacies et aux prestataires du réseau du régime

segments.src: - Changes to extra benefits such as dental, vision or hearing
segments.tr: - Les modifications apportées aux avantages supplémentaires tels que les soins dentaires, visuels ou auditifs

segments.src: Many people never open this notice.
segments.tr: Beaucoup de gens n'ouvrent jamais cet avis.

segments.src: Reading it is often the quickest way to find out whether your plan is moving in a direction that no longer suits you.
segments.tr: Le lire est souvent le moyen le plus rapide de savoir si votre plan évolue dans une direction qui ne vous convient plus.

segments.src: ## Six Things to Check Before the Deadline
segments.tr: ## Six points à vérifier avant la date limite

segments.src: ### 1. Your prescription drugs
segments.tr: ### 1. Vos médicaments sur ordonnance

segments.src: Drug coverage is where plan changes most often cause surprises.
segments.tr: La couverture des médicaments est le domaine où les changements de régime provoquent le plus souvent des surprises.

segments.src: For each medication you take, confirm:
segments.tr: Pour chaque médicament que vous prenez, confirmez :

segments.src: - Whether it is still on the plan's formulary
segments.tr: - S'il figure toujours sur le formulaire du régime

segments.src: - Which cost tier it falls into, since tiers drive your copay
segments.tr: - Dans quelle catégorie de coût il se situe, puisque les catégories déterminent votre co-paiement

segments.src: - Whether new restrictions, such as prior authorization or step therapy, now apply
segments.tr: - Si de nouvelles restrictions, telles qu'une autorisation préalable ou une thérapie séquentielle, s'appliquent désormais

segments.src: - Whether your pharmacy is still in the network, and whether it is a "preferred" pharmacy with lower costs
segments.tr: - Si votre pharmacie fait toujours partie du réseau et s'il s'agit d'une pharmacie "préférentielle" aux coûts réduits

segments.src: Part D also includes an annual cap on what you pay out of pocket for covered drugs, a feature added by recent federal law.
segments.tr: La Partie D comprend également un plafond annuel sur ce que vous payez de votre poche pour les médicaments couverts, une fonctionnalité ajoutée par une loi fédérale récente.

segments.src: The cap amount is set and adjusted by the government each year, so check the current figure at Medicare.gov rather than relying on last year's number.
segments.tr: Le montant du plafond est fixé et ajusté par le gouvernement chaque année, veuillez donc vérifier le chiffre actuel sur Medicare.gov plutôt que de vous fier au chiffre de l'année dernière.

segments.src: ### 2. Your doctors, hospitals and specialists
segments.tr: ### 2. Vos médecins, hôpitaux et spécialistes

segments.src: Original Medicare lets you see any provider who accepts Medicare, nationwide.
segments.tr: Medicare d'origine vous permet de consulter n'importe quel prestataire qui accepte Medicare, à l'échelle nationale.

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans generally use networks, and some require referrals or prior authorization for certain services.
segments.tr: Les plans Medicare Advantage utilisent généralement des réseaux, et certains exigent des recommandations ou une autorisation préalable pour certains services.

segments.src: Before you renew or switch, look up each of your doctors and any hospital you rely on, and confirm with the provider's office that they will be in the plan's network in 2027.
segments.tr: Avant de renouveler ou de changer, recherchez chacun de vos médecins et tout hôpital sur lequel vous comptez, et confirmez auprès du bureau du prestataire qu'ils feront partie du réseau du régime en 2027.

segments.src: Networks can change during the year, so asking the office directly is a good safeguard.
segments.tr: Les réseaux pouvant changer au cours de l'année, demander directement au bureau est une bonne précaution.

segments.src: ### 3. The full cost, not just the premium
segments.tr: ### 3. Le coût total, pas seulement la prime

segments.src: A low or $0 premium does not tell you what you will actually spend.
segments.tr: Une prime basse ou de 0 $ ne vous indique pas ce que vous dépenserez réellement.

segments.src: Compare:
segments.tr: Comparez :

segments.src: - Monthly premium (and your Part B premium, which most people still pay)
segments.tr: - La prime mensuelle (et votre prime de la Partie B, que la plupart des gens paient encore)

segments.src: - Annual deductible
segments.tr: - La franchise annuelle

segments.src: - Copays and coinsurance for services you use often
segments.tr: - Les co-paiements et la coassurance pour les services que vous utilisez souvent

segments.src: - The plan's maximum out-of-pocket limit for medical services
segments.tr: - La limite maximale de dépenses personnelles du régime pour les services médicaux

segments.src: - Costs for hospital stays, emergency care and skilled nursing
segments.tr: - Les coûts pour les séjours à l'hôpital, les soins d'urgence et les soins infirmiers spécialisés

segments.src: Think about both a typical year and a bad year.
segments.tr: Pensez à la fois à une année typique et à une mauvaise année.

segments.src: A plan with lower premiums but higher cost sharing can cost more if you have a health event.
segments.tr: Un plan avec des primes plus basses mais un partage des coûts plus élevé peut coûter plus cher si vous avez un problème de santé.

segments.src: ### 4. Plan quality ratings
segments.tr: ### 4. Évaluations de la qualité des plans

segments.src: Medicare rates Advantage and Part D plans on a 5-star scale based on member satisfaction and quality of care.
segments.tr: Medicare évalue les plans Advantage et de la Partie D sur une échelle de 5 étoiles en fonction de la satisfaction des membres et de la qualité des soins.

segments.src: Ratings are posted in the Medicare Plan Finder.
segments.tr: Les notes sont publiées dans le Medicare Plan Finder.

segments.src: They are not the only factor, but a plan with consistently low ratings deserves a closer look.
segments.tr: Elles ne sont pas le seul facteur, mais un plan aux notes constamment basses mérite un examen plus approfondi.

segments.src: ### 5. Extra benefits, and how they really work
segments.tr: ### 5. Avantages supplémentaires et fonctionnement réel

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans often advertise extras such as dental, vision, hearing aids, fitness programs, over-the-counter allowances or transportation.
segments.tr: Les plans Medicare Advantage annoncent souvent des extras tels que des soins dentaires, de la vision, des appareils auditifs, des programmes de conditionnement physique, des allocations en vente libre ou du transport.

segments.src: Read the details: benefits may have dollar caps, limited provider lists, or waiting periods.
segments.tr: Lisez les détails : les avantages peuvent comporter des plafonds en dollars, des listes de prestataires limitées ou des périodes de carence.

segments.src: Compare them against what you would realistically use.
segments.tr: Comparez-les à ce que vous utiliseriez réellement.

segments.src: ### 6. Your ability to switch back later
segments.tr: ### 6. Votre capacité à revenir en arrière plus tard

segments.src: This point matters if you are considering leaving Original Medicare.
segments.tr: Ce point est important si vous envisagez de quitter Medicare d'origine.

segments.src: If you buy a Medigap (Medicare Supplement) policy to cover Original Medicare's cost sharing, and later move to Medicare Advantage, you may not be able to get a Medigap policy again without answering health questions.
segments.tr: Si vous achetez une police Medigap (supplément Medicare) pour couvrir le partage des coûts de Medicare d'origine, et que vous passez ensuite à Medicare Advantage, vous ne pourrez peut-être plus souscrire à nouveau à une police Medigap sans répondre à des questions sur votre santé.

segments.src: In most states, insurers can base approval or pricing on your health history once your guaranteed-issue window has passed.
segments.tr: Dans la plupart des états, les assureurs peuvent baser l'approbation ou la tarification sur vos antécédents médicaux une fois votre période d'émission garantie passée.

segments.src: Rules differ by state, so check yours before dropping a supplement.
segments.tr: Les règles diffèrent selon l'état, alors vérifiez le vôtre avant d'abandonner un supplément.

segments.src: ## Already in Medicare Advantage? You Have a Second Chance
segments.tr: ## Vous êtes déjà dans Medicare Advantage ? Vous avez une seconde chance

segments.src: If you are in a Medicare Advantage plan, there is a separate Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period from January 1 to March 31.
segments.tr: Si vous êtes dans un plan Medicare Advantage, il existe une période d'inscription ouverte Medicare Advantage distincte du 1er janvier au 31 mars.

segments.src: During it, you can switch to a different Advantage plan or return to Original Medicare (and join a stand-alone Part D plan).
segments.tr: Pendant celle-ci, vous pouvez passer à un plan Advantage différent ou revenir à Medicare d'origine (et rejoindre un plan de la Partie D autonome).

segments.src: You cannot use it to move from Original Medicare into Advantage, and it is limited to one change.
segments.tr: Vous ne pouvez pas l'utiliser pour passer de Medicare d'origine à Advantage, et elle est limitée à un seul changement.

segments.src: It is a useful safety net, but it is better not to depend on it, since you would start the year in a plan you already suspected was a poor fit.
segments.tr: C'est un filet de sécurité utile, mais il vaut mieux ne pas en dépendre, car vous commenceriez l'année dans un plan que vous soupçonniez déjà d'être un mauvais choix.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Free, Unbiased Help
segments.tr: ## Où obtenir de l'aide gratuite et impartiale

segments.src: - **Medicare Plan Finder at Medicare.gov** lets you enter your drugs, pharmacies and ZIP code to compare plans side by side.
segments.tr: - **Le Medicare Plan Finder sur Medicare.gov** vous permet d'entrer vos médicaments, pharmacies et code postal pour comparer les plans côte à côte.

segments.src: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** connects you with Medicare directly, 24 hours a day.
segments.tr: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** vous met en relation directe avec Medicare, 24 heures sur 24.

segments.src: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIP)** offer free, one-on-one counseling from trained local counselors who do not sell insurance. Find yours at shiphelp.org.
segments.tr: - **Les programmes d'assistance pour l'assurance maladie des états (SHIP)** offrent des conseils gratuits et personnalisés de conseillers locaux formés qui ne vendent pas d'assurance. Trouvez le vôtre sur shiphelp.org.

segments.src: - **Your "Medicare & You" handbook** summarizes options and rules for the coming year.
segments.tr: - **Votre livret "Medicare & You"** résume les options et les règles pour l'année à venir.

segments.src: If you work with an insurance agent or broker, remember that they may be paid by certain plans.
segments.tr: Si vous travaillez avec un agent ou un courtier d'assurance, n'oubliez pas qu'ils peuvent être rémunérés par certains plans.

segments.src: Ask which plans they do and do not represent, and consider verifying your options in the Plan Finder as well.
segments.tr: Demandez quels plans ils représentent ou non, et envisagez de vérifier vos options également dans le Plan Finder.

segments.src: Be cautious about unsolicited phone calls, texts or door-to-door visits offering Medicare plans, and never share your Medicare number with someone you did not contact yourself.
segments.tr: Soyez prudent face aux appels téléphoniques non sollicités, aux SMS ou aux visites à domicile proposant des plans Medicare, et ne partagez jamais votre numéro Medicare avec quelqu'un que vous n'avez pas contacté vous-même.

segments.src: ## A Simple Checklist
segments.tr: ## Une liste de contrôle simple

segments.src: 1. Read your Annual Notice of Change.
segments.tr: 1. Lisez votre avis annuel de changement.

segments.src: 2. List every medication, dose and pharmacy, and test them in the Plan Finder.
segments.tr: 2. Listez chaque médicament, dose et pharmacie, et testez-les dans le Plan Finder.

segments.src: 3. Confirm your doctors and hospitals are in-network for 2027.
segments.tr: 3. Confirmez que vos médecins et hôpitaux sont dans le réseau pour 2027.

segments.src: 4. Compare total expected costs, not just premiums.
segments.tr: 4. Comparez les coûts totaux prévus, et pas seulement les primes.

segments.src: 5. Check star ratings and the details of extra benefits.
segments.tr: 5. Vérifiez les notes par étoiles et les détails des avantages supplémentaires.

segments.src: 6. If leaving Original Medicare, understand your Medigap rights first.
segments.tr: 6. Si vous quittez Medicare d'origine, comprenez d'abord vos droits Medigap.

segments.src: 7. Make your choice before **December 7**, and confirm it in writing once you enroll.
segments.tr: 7. Faites votre choix avant le **7 décembre**, et confirmez-le par écrit une fois inscrit.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: Open enrollment is a short window, and the choices you make carry through the whole year.
segments.tr: L'inscription ouverte est une courte fenêtre, et les choix que vous faites s'appliquent toute l'année.

segments.src: Spending an hour comparing options now can help you avoid unexpected bills and gaps in coverage in 2027.
segments.tr: Passer une heure à comparer les options maintenant peut vous aider à éviter des factures imprévues et des lacunes dans la couverture en 2027.

segments.src: Whether you decide to keep your current plan or change it, make it a deliberate choice rather than a default.
segments.tr: Que vous décidiez de conserver votre plan actuel ou de le changer, faites-en un choix délibéré plutôt qu'un choix par défaut.

segments.src: *Plan details, benefit amounts and deadlines can change.
segments.tr: *Les détails du plan, les montants des prestations et les dates limites peuvent changer.

segments.src: Always confirm current information with Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE before making enrollment decisions.*
segments.tr: Confirmez toujours les informations actuelles auprès de Medicare.gov ou du 1-800-MEDICARE avant de prendre des décisions d'inscription.*

segments.src: ### 5. Extra benefits, and how they really work
