segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans often advertise extras such as dental, vision, hearing aids, fitness programs, over-the-counter allowances or transportation.
segments.tr: Os planos Medicare Advantage geralmente anunciam extras, como atendimento odontológico, de visão, aparelhos auditivos, programas de condicionamento físico, subsídios para medicamentos sem receita ou transporte.

segments.src: Read the details: benefits may have dollar caps, limited provider lists, or waiting periods.
segments.tr: Leia os detalhes: os benefícios podem ter limites em dólares, listas limitadas de prestadores ou períodos de carência.

segments.src: Compare them against what you would realistically use.
segments.tr: Compare-os com o que você usaria realisticamente.

segments.src: ### 6. Your ability to switch back later
segments.tr: ### 6. Sua capacidade de voltar atrás depois

segments.src: This point matters if you are considering leaving Original Medicare.
segments.tr: Este ponto é importante se você estiver considerando deixar o Medicare Original.

segments.src: If you buy a Medigap (Medicare Supplement) policy to cover Original Medicare's cost sharing, and later move to Medicare Advantage, you may not be able to get a Medigap policy again without answering health questions.
segments.tr: Se você comprar uma apólice Medigap (Suplemento do Medicare) para cobrir o compartilhamento de custos do Medicare Original e, posteriormente, mudar para o Medicare Advantage, talvez não consiga obter uma apólice Medigap novamente sem responder a perguntas de saúde.

segments.src: In most states, insurers can base approval or pricing on your health history once your guaranteed-issue window has passed.
segments.tr: Na maioria dos estados, as seguradoras podem basear a aprovação ou os preços no seu histórico de saúde após o término da sua janela de emissão garantida.

segments.src: Rules differ by state, so check yours before dropping a supplement.
segments.tr: As regras diferem por estado, portanto, verifique as suas antes de cancelar um suplemento.

segments.src: ## Already in Medicare Advantage? You Have a Second Chance
segments.tr: ## Já está no Medicare Advantage? Você tem uma segunda chance

segments.src: If you are in a Medicare Advantage plan, there is a separate Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period from January 1 to March 31.
segments.tr: Se você estiver em um plano Medicare Advantage, há um Período de Inscrição Aberta do Medicare Advantage separado, de 1º de janeiro a 31 de março.

segments.src: During it, you can switch to a different Advantage plan or return to Original Medicare (and join a stand-alone Part D plan).
segments.tr: Durante ele, você pode mudar para um plano Advantage diferente ou retornar ao Medicare Original (e entrar em um plano avulso da Parte D).

segments.src: You cannot use it to move from Original Medicare into Advantage, and it is limited to one change.
segments.tr: Você não pode usá-lo para passar do Medicare Original para o Advantage, e ele é limitado a uma alteração.

segments.src: It is a useful safety net, but it is better not to depend on it, since you would start the year in a plan you already suspected was a poor fit.
segments.tr: É uma rede de segurança útil, mas é melhor não depender dela, já que você começaria o ano em um plano que você já suspeitava ser inadequado.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Free, Unbiased Help
segments.tr: ## Onde Obter Ajuda Gratuita e Isenta

segments.src: - **Medicare Plan Finder at Medicare.gov** lets you enter your drugs, pharmacies and ZIP code to compare plans side by side.
segments.tr: - **Medicare Plan Finder em Medicare.gov** permite que você insira seus medicamentos, farmácias e CEP para comparar planos lado a lado.

segments.src: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** connects you with Medicare directly, 24 hours a day.
segments.tr: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** conecta você diretamente ao Medicare, 24 horas por dia.

segments.src: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIP)** offer free, one-on-one counseling from trained local counselors who do not sell insurance. Find yours at shiphelp.org.
segments.tr: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIP)** oferecem aconselhamento gratuito e individual de conselheiros locais treinados que não vendem seguros. Encontre o seu em shiphelp.org.

segments.src: - **Your "Medicare & You" handbook** summarizes options and rules for the coming year.
segments.tr: - **Seu manual "Medicare & You"** resume as opções e regras para o próximo ano.

segments.src: If you work with an insurance agent or broker, remember that they may be paid by certain plans.
segments.tr: Se você trabalhar com um agente ou corretor de seguros, lembre-se de que eles podem ser pagos por determinados planos.

segments.src: Ask which plans they do and do not represent, and consider verifying your options in the Plan Finder as well.
segments.tr: Pergunte quais planos eles representam e quais não representam, e considere verificar suas opções no Plan Finder também.

segments.src: Be cautious about unsolicited phone calls, texts or door-to-door visits offering Medicare plans, and never share your Medicare number with someone you did not contact yourself.
segments.tr: Tenha cuidado com telefonemas não solicitados, mensagens de texto ou visitas de porta em porta oferecendo planos do Medicare e nunca compartilhe seu número do Medicare com alguém com quem você não entrou em contato.

segments.src: ## A Simple Checklist
segments.tr: ## Uma Lista de Verificação Simples

segments.src: 1. Read your Annual Notice of Change.
segments.tr: 1. Leia seu Aviso Anual de Mudança.

segments.src: 2. List every medication, dose and pharmacy, and test them in the Plan Finder.
segments.tr: 2. Liste todos os medicamentos, doses e farmácias e teste-os no Plan Finder.

segments.src: 3. Confirm your doctors and hospitals are in-network for 2027.
segments.tr: 3. Confirme se seus médicos e hospitais estão na rede para 2027.

segments.src: 4. Compare total expected costs, not just premiums.
segments.tr: 4. Compare os custos totais esperados, não apenas os prêmios.

segments.src: 5. Check star ratings and the details of extra benefits.
segments.tr: 5. Verifique as classificações por estrelas e os detalhes dos benefícios extras.

segments.src: 6. If leaving Original Medicare, understand your Medigap rights first.
segments.tr: 6. Se for deixar o Medicare Original, entenda primeiro seus direitos do Medigap.

segments.src: 7. Make your choice before **December 7**, and confirm it in writing once you enroll.
segments.tr: 7. Faça sua escolha antes de **7 de dezembro** e confirme-a por escrito assim que se inscrever.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## A Conclusão

segments.src: Open enrollment is a short window, and the choices you make carry through the whole year.
segments.tr: A inscrição aberta é uma janela curta, e as escolhas que você faz duram o ano todo.

segments.src: Spending an hour comparing options now can help you avoid unexpected bills and gaps in coverage in 2027.
segments.tr: Gastar uma hora comparando opções agora pode ajudar você a evitar contas inesperadas e lacunas na cobertura em 2027.

segments.src: Whether you decide to keep your current plan or change it, make it a deliberate choice rather than a default.
segments.tr: Independentemente de decidir manter seu plano atual ou alterá-lo, faça uma escolha deliberada em vez de seguir o padrão.

segments.src: *Plan details, benefit amounts and deadlines can change.
segments.tr: *Detalhes do plano, valores de benefícios e prazos podem mudar.

segments.src: Always confirm current information with Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE before making enrollment decisions.*
segments.tr: Sempre confirme as informações atuais com Medicare.gov ou 1-800-MEDICARE antes de tomar decisões de inscrição.*

in.title: Pendaftaran Terbuka Medicare Berakhir 7 Desember: Apa yang Perlu Diperiksa Sebelum Memperbarui untuk Tahun 2027

segments.src: Medicare's annual open enrollment period runs from October 15 to December 7.
segments.tr: Periode pendaftaran terbuka tahunan Medicare berlangsung dari 15 Oktober hingga 7 Desember.

segments.src: During these weeks, people with Medicare can review their coverage and make changes that take effect on January 1, 2027.
segments.tr: Selama minggu-minggu ini, peserta Medicare dapat meninjau pertanggungan mereka dan membuat perubahan yang mulai berlaku pada 1 Januari 2027.

segments.src: Because plans adjust their costs, drug lists and provider networks every year, a plan that worked well in 2026 may not be the best fit next year.
segments.tr: Karena rencana menyesuaikan biaya, daftar obat, dan jaringan penyedia layanan setiap tahun, rencana yang berfungsi baik pada 2026 mungkin tidak lagi menjadi pilihan terbaik tahun depan.

segments.src: This article is general information, not personal financial, medical or insurance advice.
segments.tr: Artikel ini adalah informasi umum, bukan nasihat keuangan, medis, atau asuransi pribadi.

segments.src: Your own situation, location and plan options will determine what makes sense for you.
segments.tr: Situasi, lokasi, dan pilihan rencana Anda sendiri akan menentukan apa yang paling masuk akal bagi Anda.

segments.src: ## What You Can Change During Open Enrollment
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Dapat Anda Ubah Selama Pendaftaran Terbuka

segments.src: Between October 15 and December 7, people with Medicare can generally:
segments.tr: Antara 15 Oktober dan 7 Desember, peserta Medicare umumnya dapat:

segments.src: - **Switch from Original Medicare to a Medicare Advantage plan (Part C)**, or the reverse.
segments.tr: - **Beralih dari Medicare Asli ke rencana Medicare Advantage (Bagian C)**, atau sebaliknya.

segments.src: - **Switch from one Medicare Advantage plan to another.**
segments.tr: - **Beralih dari satu rencana Medicare Advantage ke rencana lainnya.**

segments.src: - **Join, drop or change a Medicare Part D prescription drug plan.**
segments.tr: - **Bergabung, berhenti, atau mengubah rencana obat resep Medicare Bagian D.**

segments.src: If you are happy with your current coverage and it is not changing in ways that matter to you, you do not need to do anything.
segments.tr: Jika Anda puas dengan pertanggungan Anda saat ini dan pertanggungan tersebut tidak berubah dengan cara yang penting bagi Anda, Anda tidak perlu melakukan apa pun.

segments.src: Most plans renew automatically.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar rencana diperbarui secara otomatis.

segments.src: However, automatic renewal also means you accept next year's costs and rules, which is why a review is worthwhile.
segments.tr: Namun, pembaruan otomatis juga berarti Anda menerima biaya dan aturan tahun depan, itulah sebabnya peninjauan sangatlah berharga.

segments.src: ## Start With Your Annual Notice of Change
segments.tr: ## Mulailah dengan Pemberitahuan Perubahan Tahunan Anda

segments.src: Medicare Advantage and Part D plans are required to send current members an Annual Notice of Change (ANOC) by the end of September.
segments.tr: Rencana Medicare Advantage dan Bagian D diwajibkan untuk mengirimkan Pemberitahuan Perubahan Tahunan (ANOC) kepada anggota saat ini pada akhir September.

segments.src: Pull it out and read it carefully.
segments.tr: Keluarkan dan baca dengan saksama.

segments.src: It explains what will be different in 2027, including:
segments.tr: Dokumen ini menjelaskan apa yang akan berbeda pada tahun 2027, termasuk:

segments.src: - Monthly premiums and deductibles
segments.tr: - Premi bulanan dan denda

segments.src: - Copayments and coinsurance for doctor visits, hospital stays and specialists
segments.tr: - Pembayaran bersama (copay) dan asuransi bersama untuk kunjungan dokter, rawat inap di rumah sakit, dan spesialis

segments.src: - Changes to the list of covered drugs, known as the formulary
segments.tr: - Perubahan pada daftar obat yang ditanggung, yang dikenal sebagai formularium

segments.src: - Changes to the pharmacies and providers in the plan's network
segments.tr: - Perubahan pada apotek dan penyedia layanan dalam jaringan rencana tersebut

segments.src: - Changes to extra benefits such as dental, vision or hearing
segments.tr: - Perubahan pada manfaat tambahan seperti gigi, penglihatan, atau pendengaran

segments.src: Many people never open this notice.
segments.tr: Banyak orang tidak pernah membuka pemberitahuan ini.

segments.src: Reading it is often the quickest way to find out whether your plan is moving in a direction that no longer suits you.
segments.tr: Membacanya sering kali merupakan cara tercepat untuk mengetahui apakah rencana Anda bergerak ke arah yang tidak lagi cocok untuk Anda.

segments.src: ## Six Things to Check Before the Deadline
segments.tr: ## Enam Hal yang Perlu Diperiksa Sebelum Batas Waktu

segments.src: ### 1. Your prescription drugs
segments.tr: ### 1. Obat resep Anda

segments.src: Drug coverage is where plan changes most often cause surprises.
segments.tr: Pertanggungan obat adalah hal di mana perubahan rencana paling sering menimbulkan kejutan.

segments.src: For each medication you take, confirm:
segments.tr: Untuk setiap obat yang Anda konsumsi, konfirmasikan:

segments.src: - Whether it is still on the plan's formulary
segments.tr: - Apakah obat tersebut masih ada dalam formularium rencana

segments.src: - Which cost tier it falls into, since tiers drive your copay
segments.tr: - Masuk ke dalam tingkat biaya mana obat tersebut, karena tingkat biaya menentukan copay Anda

segments.src: - Whether new restrictions, such as prior authorization or step therapy, now apply
segments.tr: - Apakah batasan baru, seperti otorisasi sebelumnya atau terapi bertahap, kini berlaku

segments.src: - Whether your pharmacy is still in the network, and whether it is a "preferred" pharmacy with lower costs
segments.tr: - Apakah apotek Anda masih berada di dalam jaringan, dan apakah apotek tersebut adalah apotek "unggulan" dengan biaya lebih rendah

segments.src: Part D also includes an annual cap on what you pay out of pocket for covered drugs, a feature added by recent federal law.
segments.tr: Bagian D juga mencakup batas tahunan atas apa yang Anda bayar dari kantong sendiri untuk obat yang ditanggung, fitur yang ditambahkan oleh undang-undang federal baru-baru ini.

segments.src: The cap amount is set and adjusted by the government each year, so check the current figure at Medicare.gov rather than relying on last year's number.
segments.tr: Jumlah batasan ditetapkan dan disesuaikan oleh pemerintah setiap tahun, jadi periksalah angka saat ini di Medicare.gov daripada mengandalkan angka tahun lalu.

segments.src: ### 2. Your doctors, hospitals and specialists
segments.tr: ### 2. Dokter, rumah sakit, dan spesialis Anda

segments.src: Original Medicare lets you see any provider who accepts Medicare, nationwide.
segments.tr: Medicare Asli memungkinkan Anda menemui penyedia layanan apa pun yang menerima Medicare, di seluruh negeri.

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans generally use networks, and some require referrals or prior authorization for certain services.
segments.tr: Rencana Medicare Advantage umumnya menggunakan jaringan, dan beberapa memerlukan rujukan atau otorisasi sebelumnya untuk layanan tertentu.

segments.src: Before you renew or switch, look up each of your doctors and any hospital you rely on, and confirm with the provider's office that they will be in the plan's network in 2027.
segments.tr: Sebelum Anda memperbarui atau beralih, cari tahu setiap dokter Anda dan rumah sakit mana pun yang Anda Andalkan, dan konfirmasikan dengan kantor penyedia layanan bahwa mereka akan berada di dalam jaringan rencana pada tahun 2027.

segments.src: Networks can change during the year, so asking the office directly is a good safeguard.
segments.tr: Jaringan dapat berubah selama tahun berjalan, jadi bertanya langsung kepada kantor terkait adalah tindakan pencegahan yang baik.

segments.src: ### 3. The full cost, not just the premium
segments.tr: ### 3. Biaya penuh, bukan hanya premi

segments.src: A low or $0 premium does not tell you what you will actually spend.
segments.tr: Premi yang rendah atau $0 tidak menunjukkan berapa banyak yang akan sebenarnya Anda keluarkan.

segments.src: Compare:
segments.tr: Bandingkan:

segments.src: - Monthly premium (and your Part B premium, which most people still pay)
segments.tr: - Premi bulanan (serta premi Bagian B Anda, yang sebagian besar masih dibayar oleh orang-orang)

segments.src: - Annual deductible
segments.tr: - Pengurangan tahunan (deductible)

segments.src: - Copays and coinsurance for services you use often
segments.tr: - Copay dan asuransi bersama untuk layanan yang sering Anda gunakan

segments.src: - The plan's maximum out-of-pocket limit for medical services
segments.tr: - Batas maksimum pengeluaran pribadi (out-of-pocket) rencana untuk layanan medis

segments.src: - Costs for hospital stays, emergency care and skilled nursing
segments.tr: - Biaya untuk rawat inap di rumah sakit, perawatan darurat, dan perawatan keperawatan terampil

segments.src: Think about both a typical year and a bad year.
segments.tr: Pikirkan tentang tahun yang normal maupun tahun yang buruk.

segments.src: A plan with lower premiums but higher cost sharing can cost more if you have a health event.
segments.tr: Rencana dengan premi lebih rendah tetapi pembagian biaya yang lebih tinggi bisa jadi lebih mahal jika Anda mengalami masalah kesehatan.

segments.src: ### 4. Plan quality ratings
segments.tr: ### 4. Peringkat kualitas rencana

segments.src: Medicare rates Advantage and Part D plans on a 5-star scale based on member satisfaction and quality of care.
segments.tr: Medicare menilai rencana Advantage dan Bagian D pada skala 5 bintang berdasarkan kepuasan anggota dan kualitas perawatan.

segments.src: Ratings are posted in the Medicare Plan Finder.
segments.tr: Peringkat diposting di Pencari Rencana Medicare (Medicare Plan Finder).

segments.src: They are not the only factor, but a plan with consistently low ratings deserves a closer look.
segments.tr: Peringkat ini bukan satu-satunya faktor, tetapi rencana dengan peringkat yang konsisten rendah patut diteliti lebih dekat.

segments.src: ### 5. Extra benefits, and how they really work
segments.tr: ### 5. Manfaat tambahan, dan bagaimana cara kerjanya sebenarnya

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans often advertise extras such as dental, vision, hearing aids, fitness programs, over-the-counter allowances or transportation.
segments.tr: Rencana Medicare Advantage sering kali mengiklankan fasilitas tambahan seperti gigi, penglihatan, alat bantu dengar, program kebugaran, tunjangan obat bebas, atau transportasi.

segments.src: Read the details: benefits may have dollar caps, limited provider lists, or waiting periods.
segments.tr: Baca detailnya: manfaat mungkin memiliki batasan dolar, daftar penyedia layanan yang terbatas, atau masa tunggu.

segments.src: Compare them against what you would realistically use.
segments.tr: Bandingkan manfaat tersebut dengan apa yang benar-benar akan Anda gunakan secara realistis.

segments.src: ### 6. Your ability to switch back later
segments.tr: ### 6. Kemampuan Anda untuk beralih kembali nanti

segments.src: This point matters if you are considering leaving Original Medicare.
segments.tr: Poin ini penting jika Anda sedang mempertimbangkan untuk meninggalkan Medicare Asli.

segments.src: If you buy a Medigap (Medicare Supplement) policy to cover Original Medicare's cost sharing, and later move to Medicare Advantage, you may not be able to get a Medigap policy again without answering health questions.
segments.tr: Jika Anda membeli polis Medigap (Suplemen Medicare) untuk menutupi pembagian biaya Medicare Asli, dan kemudian beralih ke Medicare Advantage, Anda mungkin tidak dapat mendapatkan polis Medigap lagi tanpa menjawab pertanyaan kesehatan.

segments.src: In most states, insurers can base approval or pricing on your health history once your guaranteed-issue window has passed.
segments.tr: Di sebagian besar negara bagian, perusahaan asuransi dapat mendasarkan persetujuan atau penetapan harga pada riwayat kesehatan Anda setelah jendela penerbitan terjamin Anda berlalu.

segments.src: Rules differ by state, so check yours before dropping a supplement.
segments.tr: Aturan berbeda di setiap negara bagian, jadi periksa aturan di wilayah Anda sebelum menghentikan suplemen.

segments.src: ## Already in Medicare Advantage? You Have a Second Chance
segments.tr: ## Sudah Terdaftar di Medicare Advantage? Anda Memiliki Kesempatan Kedua

segments.src: If you are in a Medicare Advantage plan, there is a separate Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period from January 1 to March 31.
segments.tr: Jika Anda berada dalam rencana Medicare Advantage, ada Periode Pendaftaran Terbuka Medicare Advantage terpisah dari 1 Januari hingga 31 Maret.

segments.src: During it, you can switch to a different Advantage plan or return to Original Medicare (and join a stand-alone Part D plan).
segments.tr: Selama periode ini, Anda dapat beralih ke rencana Advantage yang berbeda atau kembali ke Medicare Asli (dan bergabung dengan rencana Bagian D mandiri).

segments.src: You cannot use it to move from Original Medicare into Advantage, and it is limited to one change.
segments.tr: Anda tidak dapat menggunakannya untuk pindah dari Medicare Asli ke Advantage, dan ini terbatas pada satu kali perubahan.

segments.src: It is a useful safety net, but it is better not to depend on it, since you would start the year in a plan you already suspected was a poor fit.
segments.tr: Ini adalah jaring pengaman yang berguna, tetapi lebih baik tidak mengandalkannya, karena Anda akan memulai tahun ini dengan rencana yang sudah Anda curigai tidak cocok.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Free, Unbiased Help
segments.tr: ## Tempat Mendapatkan Bantuan Gratis dan Tidak Memihak

segments.src: - **Medicare Plan Finder at Medicare.gov** lets you enter your drugs, pharmacies and ZIP code to compare plans side by side.
segments.tr: - **Medicare Plan Finder di Medicare.gov** memungkinkan Anda memasukkan obat, apotek, dan kode pos Anda untuk membandingkan rencana secara berdampingan.

segments.src: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** connects you with Medicare directly, 24 hours a day.
segments.tr: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** menghubungkan Anda langsung dengan Medicare, 24 jam sehari.

segments.src: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIP)** offer free, one-on-one counseling from trained local counselors who do not sell insurance. Find yours at shiphelp.org.
segments.tr: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIP)** menawarkan konseling gratis satu lawan satu dari konselor lokal terlatih yang tidak menjual asuransi. Temukan milik Anda di shiphelp.org.

segments.src: - **Your "Medicare & You" handbook** summarizes options and rules for the coming year.
segments.tr: - **Buku panduan "Medicare & You" Anda** merangkum pilihan dan aturan untuk tahun mendatang.

segments.src: If you work with an insurance agent or broker, remember that they may be paid by certain plans.
segments.tr: Jika Anda bekerja dengan agen atau pialang asuransi, ingatlah bahwa mereka mungkin dibayar oleh rencana tertentu.

segments.src: Ask which plans they do and do not represent, and consider verifying your options in the Plan Finder as well.
segments.tr: Tanyakan rencana apa saja yang mereka wakili dan tidak wakili, dan pertimbangkan untuk memverifikasi pilihan Anda di Plan Finder juga.

segments.src: Be cautious about unsolicited phone calls, texts or door-to-door visits offering Medicare plans, and never share your Medicare number with someone you did not contact yourself.
segments.tr: Berhati-hatilah terhadap panggilan telepon, teks, atau kunjungan dari rumah ke rumah yang tidak diminta yang menawarkan rencana Medicare, dan jangan pernah membagikan nomor Medicare Anda kepada seseorang yang tidak Anda hubungi sendiri.

segments.src: ## A Simple Checklist
segments.tr: ## Daftar Periksa Sederhana

segments.src: 1. Read your Annual Notice of Change.
segments.tr: 1. Baca Pemberitahuan Perubahan Tahunan Anda.

segments.src: 2. List every medication, dose and pharmacy, and test them in the Plan Finder.
segments.tr: 2. Daftarkan setiap obat, dosis, dan apotek, lalu uji di Plan Finder.

segments.src: 3. Confirm your doctors and hospitals are in-network for 2027.
segments.tr: 3. Konfirmasikan dokter dan rumah sakit Anda masuk dalam jaringan untuk tahun 2027.

segments.src: 4. Compare total expected costs, not just premiums.
segments.tr: 4. Bandingkan total perkiraan biaya, bukan hanya premi.

segments.src: 5. Check star ratings and the details of extra benefits.
segments.tr: 5. Periksa peringkat bintang dan detail manfaat tambahan.

segments.src: 6. If leaving Original Medicare, understand your Medigap rights first.
segments.tr: 6. Jika meninggalkan Medicare Asli, pahami hak Medigap Anda terlebih dahulu.

segments.src: 7. Make your choice before **December 7**, and confirm it in writing once you enroll.
segments.tr: 7. Buat pilihan Anda sebelum **7 Desember**, dan konfirmasikan secara tertulis setelah Anda mendaftar.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: Open enrollment is a short window, and the choices you make carry through the whole year.
segments.tr: Pendaftaran terbuka adalah jendela waktu yang singkat, dan pilihan yang Anda buat berlaku sepanjang tahun.

segments.src: Spending an hour comparing options now can help you avoid unexpected bills and gaps in coverage in 2027.
segments.tr: Menghabiskan waktu satu jam untuk membandingkan opsi sekarang dapat membantu Anda menghindari tagihan tak terduga dan celah pertanggungan pada tahun 2027.

segments.src: Whether you decide to keep your current plan or change it, make it a deliberate choice rather than a default.

ja.title: メディケアのオープン・エンロールメント（加入申込期間）は12月7日に終了：2027年の更新前に確認すべきこと

segments.src: Medicare's annual open enrollment period runs from October 15 to December 7.
segments.tr: メディケアの年間オープン・エンロールメント期間は10月15日から12月7日までです。

segments.src: During these weeks, people with Medicare can review their coverage and make changes that take effect on January 1, 2027.
segments.tr: この数週間の間に、メディケア加入者は補償内容を見直し、2027年1月1日付で有効となる変更を行うことができます。

segments.src: Because plans adjust their costs, drug lists and provider networks every year, a plan that worked well in 2026 may not be the best fit next year.
segments.tr: プランは毎年、費用、薬剤リスト、プロバイダーネットワークを調整するため、2026年にうまく機能していたプランが来年も最適であるとは限りません。

segments.src: This article is general information, not personal financial, medical or insurance advice.
segments.tr: この記事は一般的な情報提供を目的としたものであり、個人的な財務、医療、保険に関するアドバイスではありません。

segments.src: Your own situation, location and plan options will determine what makes sense for you.
segments.tr: ご自身の状況、お住まいの地域、プランの選択肢によって、自分にとって何が適切であるかが決まります。

segments.src: ## What You Can Change During Open Enrollment
segments.tr: ## オープン・エンロールメント期間中に変更できること

segments.src: Between October 15 and December 7, people with Medicare can generally:
segments.tr: 10月15日から12月7日の間、メディケア加入者は一般的に次のことができます。

segments.src: - **Switch from Original Medicare to a Medicare Advantage plan (Part C)**, or the reverse.
segments.tr: - **オリジナル・メディケアからメディケア・アドバンテージ・プラン（パートC）への切り替え**、またはその逆。

segments.src: - **Switch from one Medicare Advantage plan to another.**
segments.tr: - **あるメディケア・アドバンテージ・プランから別のプランへの切り替え。**

segments.src: - **Join, drop or change a Medicare Part D prescription drug plan.**
segments.tr: - **メディケア・パートD処方薬プランへの加入、解約、または変更。**

segments.src: If you are happy with your current coverage and it is not changing in ways that matter to you, you do not need to do anything.
segments.tr: 現在の補償内容に満足しており、自分にとって重要な点で変更がない場合、何もする必要はありません。

segments.src: Most plans renew automatically.
segments.tr: ほとんどのプランは自動的に更新されます。

segments.src: However, automatic renewal also means you accept next year's costs and rules, which is why a review is worthwhile.
segments.tr: しかし、自動更新は来年の費用やルールを受け入れることも意味するため、見直しを行う価値があります。

segments.src: ## Start With Your Annual Notice of Change
segments.tr: ## 年次変更通知（ANOC）から始める

segments.src: Medicare Advantage and Part D plans are required to send current members an Annual Notice of Change (ANOC) by the end of September.
segments.tr: メディケア・アドバンテージおよびパートDプランは、9月末までに現在の加入者に年次変更通知（ANOC）を送付することが義務付けられています。

segments.src: Pull it out and read it carefully.
segments.tr: それを手元に取り出し、注意深く読んでください。

segments.src: It explains what will be different in 2027, including:
segments.tr: 以下を含め、2027年に何が変更されるかが説明されています。

segments.src: - Monthly premiums and deductibles
segments.tr: - 月額保険料と免責金額

segments.src: - Copayments and coinsurance for doctor visits, hospital stays and specialists
segments.tr: - 医師の診察、入院、専門医受診に対する自己負担額（コペイメント）と共同保険

segments.src: - Changes to the list of covered drugs, known as the formulary
segments.tr: - フォーミュラリーとして知られる、カバーされる薬剤リストの変更

segments.src: - Changes to the pharmacies and providers in the plan's network
segments.tr: - プランのネットワークに含まれる薬局およびプロバイダーの変更

segments.src: - Changes to extra benefits such as dental, vision or hearing
segments.tr: - 歯科、視力、聴力などの追加給付の変更

segments.src: Many people never open this notice.
segments.tr: 多くの人はこの通知を開封することすらありません。

segments.src: Reading it is often the quickest way to find out whether your plan is moving in a direction that no longer suits you.
segments.tr: これを読むことは、お使いのプランが自分に合わなくなっている方向に進んでいるかどうかを確かめる最も早い方法であることがよくあります。

segments.src: ## Six Things to Check Before the Deadline
segments.tr: ## 期限前に確認すべき6つのこと

segments.src: ### 1. Your prescription drugs
Drug coverage is where plan changes most often cause surprises.
segments.tr: 薬剤の補償に関しては、プランの変更によって最も予期せぬ事態が起こりやすい領域です。

segments.src: For each medication you take, confirm:
segments.tr: 服用している各薬剤について、以下を確認してください。

segments.src: - Whether it is still on the plan's formulary
segments.tr: - プランのフォーミュラリーにまだ含まれているかどうか

segments.src: - Which cost tier it falls into, since tiers drive your copay
segments.tr: - 自己負担額を左右する、どのコストティア（段階）に属しているか

segments.src: - Whether new restrictions, such as prior authorization or step therapy, now apply
segments.tr: - 事前承認やステップセラピーなどの新しい制限が適用されているかどうか

segments.src: - Whether your pharmacy is still in the network, and whether it is a "preferred" pharmacy with lower costs
segments.tr: - お近くの薬局が引き続きネットワークに含まれているか、またコストが低い「推奨」薬局であるかどうか

segments.src: Part D also includes an annual cap on what you pay out of pocket for covered drugs, a feature added by recent federal law.
segments.tr: パートDには、最近の連邦法によって追加された、カバーされる薬剤の自己負担額に対する年間上限も含まれています。

segments.src: The cap amount is set and adjusted by the government each year, so check the current figure at Medicare.gov rather than relying on last year's number.
segments.tr: 上限額は毎年政府によって設定および調整されるため、昨年の数字に頼るのではなく、Medicare.govで現在の数値を確認してください。

segments.src: ### 2. Your doctors, hospitals and specialists
segments.tr: ### 2. 医師、病院、専門医

segments.src: Original Medicare lets you see any provider who accepts Medicare, nationwide.
segments.tr: オリジナル・メディケアでは、全国どこでもメディケアを受け入れるプロバイダーであれば誰でも受診できます。

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans generally use networks, and some require referrals or prior authorization for certain services.
segments.tr: メディケア・アドバンテージ・プランは一般的にネットワークを使用しており、特定のサービスには紹介状や事前承認が必要な場合もあります。

segments.src: Before you renew or switch, look up each of your doctors and any hospital you rely on, and confirm with the provider's office that they will be in the plan's network in 2027.
segments.tr: 更新または切り替えを行う前に、かかりつけの医師や頼りにしている病院をそれぞれ調べ、2027年にプランのネットワークに含まれることをプロバイダーのオフィスで確認してください。

segments.src: Networks can change during the year, so asking the office directly is a good safeguard.
segments.tr: ネットワークは年間を通じて変更される可能性があるため、オフィスに直接尋ねることが良い安全策となります。

segments.src: ### 3. The full cost, not just the premium
segments.tr: ### 3. 保険料だけでなく、総費用を確認する

segments.src: A low or $0 premium does not tell you what you will actually spend.
segments.tr: 保険料が低い、または0ドルの場合、実際に自分がいくら支払うことになるかはわかりません。

segments.src: Compare:
segments.tr: 以下を比較してください。

segments.src: - Monthly premium (and your Part B premium, which most people still pay)
segments.tr: - 月額保険料（および、ほとんどの人が依然として支払っているパートB保険料）

segments.src: - Annual deductible
segments.tr: - 年間免責金額

segments.src: - Copays and coinsurance for services you use often
segments.tr: - 頻繁に利用するサービスに対する自己負担額と共同保険

segments.src: - The plan's maximum out-of-pocket limit for medical services
segments.tr: - 医療サービスのプランの年間自己負担上限額

segments.src: - Costs for hospital stays, emergency care and skilled nursing
segments.tr: - 入院、救急医療、熟練看護の費用

segments.src: Think about both a typical year and a bad year.
segments.tr: 通常の年と健康上の問題があった年の両方を想定してください。

segments.src: A plan with lower premiums but higher cost sharing can cost more if you have a health event.
segments.tr: - 保険料は安いが自己負担割合が高いプランは、健康上のイベントが発生した場合に費用が高くなる可能性があります。

segments.src: ### 4. Plan quality ratings
segments.tr: ### 4. プランの品質評価

segments.src: Medicare rates Advantage and Part D plans on a 5-star scale based on member satisfaction and quality of care.
segments.tr: メディケアは、加入者の満足度とケアの質に基づいて、アドバンテージおよびパートDプランを5つ星評価で評価しています。

segments.src: Ratings are posted in the Medicare Plan Finder.
segments.tr: 評価はメディケア・プラン・ファインダーに掲載されています。

segments.src: They are not the only factor, but a plan with consistently low ratings deserves a closer look.
segments.tr: これらは唯一の要素ではありませんが、一貫して低い評価を受けているプランは、より詳しく調べる価値があります。

segments.src: ### 5. Extra benefits, and how they really work
segments.tr: ### 5. 追加給付と、それが実際にどのように機能するか

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans often advertise extras such as dental, vision, hearing aids, fitness programs, over-the-counter allowances or transportation.
segments.tr: メディケア・アドバンテージ・プランは、歯科、視力、補聴器、フィットネスプログラム、市販薬の手当、交通手段などの追加特典を頻繁に宣伝しています。

segments.src: Read the details: benefits may have dollar caps, limited provider lists, or waiting periods.
segments.tr: 詳細を読んでください：給付には金額の上限、制限されたプロバイダーリスト、または待機期間がある場合があります。

segments.src: Compare them against what you would realistically use.
segments.tr: 自分が現実的に利用するであろうものと照らし合わせて比較してください。

segments.src: ### 6. Your ability to switch back later
segments.tr: ### 6. 後から切り替える能力

segments.src: This point matters if you are considering leaving Original Medicare.
segments.tr: この点は、オリジナル・メディケアの解散を検討している場合に重要です。

segments.src: If you buy a Medigap (Medicare Supplement) policy to cover Original Medicare's cost sharing, and later move to Medicare Advantage, you may not be able to get a Medigap policy again without answering health questions.
segments.tr: オリジナル・メディケアの自己負担をカバーするためにメディギャップ（メディケア補足保険）ポリシーを購入し、後からメディケア・アドバンテージに移行した場合、健康に関する質問に答えなければ、再びメディギャップポリシーを取得できない可能性があります。

segments.src: In most states, insurers can base approval or pricing on your health history once your guaranteed-issue window has passed.
segments.tr: ほとんどの州では、保証発行期間が過ぎると、保険会社は健康履歴に基づいて承認や価格設定を行うことができます。

segments.src: Rules differ by state, so check yours before dropping a supplement.
segments.tr: ルールは州によって異なるため、サプリメントを解約する前に自分の州のルールを確認してください。

segments.src: ## Already in Medicare Advantage? You Have a Second Chance
segments.tr: ## すでにメディケア・アドバンテージに加入していますか？ 2度目のチャンスがあります

segments.src: If you are in a Medicare Advantage plan, there is a separate Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period from January 1 to March 31.
segments.tr: メディケア・アドバンテージ・プランに加入している場合、1月1日から3月31日まで別のメディケア・アドバンテージ・オープン・エンロールメント期間があります。

segments.src: During it, you can switch to a different Advantage plan or return to Original Medicare (and join a stand-alone Part D plan).
segments.tr: この期間中、別の有利なプランに切り替えるか、オリジナル・メディケアに戻る（および単体のパートDプランに加入する）ことができます。

segments.src: You cannot use it to move from Original Medicare into Advantage, and it is limited to one change.
segments.tr: これを使用してオリジナル・メディケアからアドバンテージに移行することはできず、変更は1回に制限されています。

segments.src: It is a useful safety net, but it is better not to depend on it, since you would start the year in a plan you already suspected was a poor fit.
segments.tr: これは有用な安全ネットですが、最初から自分には合わないと疑っていたプランで年を始めることになるため、それに頼らない方が賢明です。

segments.src: ## Where to Get Free, Unbiased Help
segments.tr: ## 無料で偏りのない支援を受ける場所

segments.src: - **Medicare Plan Finder at Medicare.gov** lets you enter your drugs, pharmacies and ZIP code to compare plans side by side.
segments.tr: - **Medicare.govのメディケア・プラン・ファインダー**では、薬剤、薬局、郵便番号を入力して、プランを並べて比較できます。

segments.src: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** connects you with Medicare directly, 24 hours a day.
segments.tr: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)**は、24時間体制でメディケアに直接つながります。

segments.src: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIP)** offer free, one-on-one counseling from trained local counselors who do not sell insurance. Find yours at shiphelp.org.
segments.tr: - **州健康保険支援プログラム（SHIP）**は、保険を販売しない訓練を受けた地元のカウンセラーによる無料の個別カウンセリングを提供しています。 shiphelp.orgであなたの州のプログラムを見つけてください。

segments.src: - **Your "Medicare & You" handbook** summarizes options and rules for the coming year.
segments.tr: - **あなたの「Medicare & You」ハンドブック**には、来年のオプションとルールが要約されています。

segments.src: If you work with an insurance agent or broker, remember that they may be paid by certain plans.
segments.tr: 保険代理店やブローカーと協力する場合は、特定のプランから報酬を受け取っている可能性があることに留意してください。

segments.src: Ask which plans they do and do not represent, and consider verifying your options in the Plan Finder as well.
segments.tr: どのプランを代表していて、どれを代表していないかを尋ね、プラン・ファインダーでもオプションを確認することを検討してください。

segments.src: Be cautious about unsolicited phone calls, texts or door-to-door visits offering Medicare plans, and never share your Medicare number with someone you did not contact yourself.
segments.tr: メディケアプランを提供する、不審な電話、テキストメッセージ、戸別訪問には注意し、自分から連絡していない相手にメディケア番号を絶対に教えないでください。

segments.src: ## A Simple Checklist
segments.tr: ## シンプルなチェックリスト

segments.src: 1. Read your Annual Notice of Change.
segments.tr: 1. 年次変更通知（ANOC）を読む。

segments.src: 2. List every medication, dose and pharmacy, and test them in the Plan Finder.
segments.tr: 2. すべての薬、用量、薬局をリストアップし、プラン・ファインダーでテストする。

segments.src: 3. Confirm your doctors and hospitals are in-network for 2027.
segments.tr: 3. 医師と病院が2027年のネットワーク内にあることを確認する。

segments.src: 4. Compare total expected costs, not just premiums.
segments.tr: 4. 保険料だけでなく、予想される総費用を比較する。

segments.src: 5. Check star ratings and the details of extra benefits.
segments.tr: 5. 星評価と追加給付の詳細を確認する。

segments.src: 6. If leaving Original Medicare, understand your Medigap rights first.
segments.tr: 6. オリジナル・メディケアを離れる場合は、まず自分のメディギャップの権利を理解する。

segments.src: 7. Make your choice before **December 7**, and confirm it in writing once you enroll.
segments.tr: 7. **12月7日**までに選択を行い、加入したら書面で確認する。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: Open enrollment is a short window, and the choices you make carry through the whole year.
segments.tr: オープン・エンロールメントは短い期間であり、あなたが下す選択は一年中続きます。

segments.src: Spending an hour comparing options now can help you avoid unexpected bills and gaps in coverage in 2027.
segments.tr: 今、オプションの比較に1時間を費やすことで、2027年の予期せぬ請求や補償のギャップを回避するのに役立ちます。

segments.src: Whether you decide to keep your current plan or change it, make it a deliberate choice rather than a default.
segments.tr: 現在のプランを維持するか変更するかに関わらず、デフォルトではなく意図的な選択にしてください。

segments.src: *Plan details, benefit amounts and deadlines can change.
segments.tr: *プランの詳細、給付金額、期限は変更される可能性があります。

segments.src: Always confirm current information with Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE before making enrollment decisions.*
segments.tr: 加入決定を行う前に、必ずMedicare.govまたは1-800-MEDICAREで最新の情報を確認してください。*

segments.src: - Changes to extra benefits such as dental, vision or hearing
segments.tr: - Änderungen bei Zusatzleistungen wie Zahn-, Seh- oder Hörhilfen

segments.src: Many people never open this notice.
segments.tr: Viele Menschen öffnen diese Mitteilung nie.

segments.src: Reading it is often the quickest way to find out whether your plan is moving in a direction that no longer suits you.
segments.tr: Sie zu lesen ist oft der schnellste Weg, um herauszufinden, ob sich Ihr Tarif in eine Richtung entwickelt, die nicht mehr zu Ihnen passt.

segments.src: ## Six Things to Check Before the Deadline
segments.tr: ## Sechs Dinge, die Sie vor Ablauf der Frist prüfen sollten

segments.src: ### 1. Your prescription drugs
segments.tr: ### 1. Ihre verschreibungspflichtigen Medikamente

segments.src: Drug coverage is where plan changes most often cause surprises.
segments.tr: Die Medikamentenabdeckung ist der Bereich, in dem Tarifänderungen am häufigsten zu Überraschungen führen.

segments.src: For each medication you take, confirm:
segments.tr: Bestätigen Sie für jedes von Ihnen eingenommene Medikament:

segments.src: - Whether it is still on the plan's formulary
segments.tr: - Ob es sich noch auf der Medikamentenliste (Formulary) des Tarifs befindet

segments.src: - Which cost tier it falls into, since tiers drive your copay
segments.tr: - In welche Kostenstufe es fällt, da Stufen Ihre Zuzahlung bestimmen

segments.src: - Whether new restrictions, such as prior authorization or step therapy, now apply
segments.tr: - Ob nun neue Einschränkungen wie vorherige Genehmigungen (Prior Authorization) oder Stufentherapien gelten

segments.src: - Whether your pharmacy is still in the network, and whether it is a "preferred" pharmacy with lower costs
segments.tr: - Ob Ihre Apotheke noch im Netzwerk ist und ob es sich um eine "bevorzugte" (preferred) Apotheke mit niedrigeren Kosten handelt

segments.src: Part D also includes an annual cap on what you pay out of pocket for covered drugs, a feature added by recent federal law.
segments.tr: Part D enthält auch eine jährliche Obergrenze für Ihre Zuzahlungen für abgedeckte Medikamente, ein Merkmal, das durch jüngste Bundesgesetze hinzugefügt wurde.

segments.src: The cap amount is set and adjusted by the government each year, so check the current figure at Medicare.gov rather than relying on last year's number.
segments.tr: Der Höchstbetrag wird jedes Jahr von der Regierung festgelegt und angepasst. Überprüfen Sie daher den aktuellen Betrag auf Medicare.gov, anstatt sich auf die Zahl des letzten Jahres zu verlassen.

segments.src: ### 2. Your doctors, hospitals and specialists
segments.tr: ### 2. Ihre Ärzte, Krankenhäuser und Fachärzte

segments.src: Original Medicare lets you see any provider who accepts Medicare, nationwide.
segments.tr: Mit Original Medicare können Sie bundesweit jeden Arzt aufsuchen, der Medicare akzeptiert.

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans generally use networks, and some require referrals or prior authorization for certain services.
segments.tr: Medicare Advantage-Tarife verwenden im Allgemeinen Netzwerke, und einige erfordern Überweisungen oder eine vorherige Genehmigung für bestimmte Leistungen.

segments.src: Before you renew or switch, look up each of your doctors and any hospital you rely on, and confirm with the provider's office that they will be in the plan's network in 2027.
segments.tr: Bevor Sie verlängern oder wechseln, suchen Sie jeden Ihrer Ärzte und jedes Krankenhaus, auf das Sie sich verlassen, heraus und bestätigen Sie mit der Praxis des Anbieters, dass sie 2027 im Netzwerk des Tarifs sein werden.

segments.src: Networks can change during the year, so asking the office directly is a good safeguard.
segments.tr: Netzwerke können sich im Laufe des Jahres ändern, daher ist die direkte Nachfrage in der Praxis eine gute Absicherung.

segments.src: ### 3. The full cost, not just the premium
segments.tr: ### 3. Die Gesamtkosten, nicht nur die Prämie

segments.src: A low or $0 premium does not tell you what you will actually spend.
segments.tr: Eine niedrige oder 0-$-Prämie sagt Ihnen nicht, was Sie tatsächlich ausgeben werden.

segments.src: Compare:
segments.tr: Vergleichen Sie:

segments.src: - Monthly premium (and your Part B premium, which most people still pay)
segments.tr: - Monatliche Prämie (sowie Ihre Part B-Prämie, die die meisten Menschen weiterhin bezahlen)

segments.src: - Annual deductible
segments.tr: - Jährliche Selbstbeteiligung

segments.src: - Copays and coinsurance for services you use often
segments.tr: - Zuzahlungen und Mitversicherungsbeiträge für Dienste, die Sie häufig nutzen

segments.src: - The plan's maximum out-of-pocket limit for medical services
segments.tr: - Die maximale Eigenbeteiligungsgrenze des Tarifs für medizinische Dienstleistungen

segments.src: - Costs for hospital stays, emergency care and skilled nursing
segments.tr: - Kosten für Krankenhausaufenthalte, Notfallversorgung und Kurzzeitpflege

segments.src: Think about both a typical year and a bad year.
segments.tr: Denken Sie sowohl an ein typisches Jahr als auch an ein schlechtes Jahr.

segments.src: A plan with lower premiums but higher cost sharing can cost more if you have a health event.
segments.tr: Ein Tarif mit niedrigeren Prämien, aber höheren Kostenbeteiligungen kann teurer sein, wenn Sie ein gesundheitliches Ereignis haben.

segments.src: ### 4. Plan quality ratings
segments.tr: ### 4. Qualitätsbewertungen der Tarife

segments.src: Medicare rates Advantage and Part D plans on a 5-star scale based on member satisfaction and quality of care.
segments.tr: Medicare bewertet Advantage- und Part D-Tarife auf einer 5-Sterne-Skala basierend auf der Kundenzufriedenheit und der Qualität der Versorgung.

segments.src: Ratings are posted in the Medicare Plan Finder.
segments.tr: Die Bewertungen werden im Medicare Plan Finder veröffentlicht.

segments.src: They are not the only factor, but a plan with consistently low ratings deserves a closer look.
segments.tr: Sie sind nicht der einzige Faktor, aber ein Tarif mit durchgehend niedrigen Bewertungen verdient einen genaueren Blick.

segments.src: ### 5. Extra benefits, and how they really work
segments.tr: ### 5. Zusatzleistungen und wie sie wirklich funktionieren

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans often advertise extras such as dental, vision, hearing aids, fitness programs, over-the-counter allowances or transportation.
segments.tr: Medicare Advantage-Tarife werben oft mit Extras wie Zahn-, Seh-, Hörgeräten, Fitnessprogrammen, Zuschüssen für rezeptfreie Medikamente oder Transport.

segments.src: Read the details: benefits may have dollar caps, limited provider lists, or waiting periods.
segments.tr: Lesen Sie die Details: Leistungen können Obergrenzen in Dollar, begrenzte Anbieterlisten oder Wartezeiten haben.

segments.src: Compare them against what you would realistically use.
segments.tr: Vergleichen Sie sie mit dem, was Sie realistischerweise nutzen würden.

segments.src: ### 6. Your ability to switch back later
segments.tr: ### 6. Ihre Fähigkeit, später wieder zurückzuwechseln

segments.src: This point matters if you are considering leaving Original Medicare.
segments.tr: Dieser Punkt ist wichtig, wenn Sie erwägen, Original Medicare zu verlassen.

segments.src: If you buy a Medigap (Medicare Supplement) policy to cover Original Medicare's cost sharing, and later move to Medicare Advantage, you may not be able to get a Medigap policy again without answering health questions.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie eine Medigap-Police (Medicare Supplement) kaufen, um die Kostenbeteiligung von Original Medicare abzudecken, und später zu Medicare Advantage wechseln, können Sie möglicherweise keine Medigap-Police mehr erhalten, ohne Gesundheitsfragen zu beantworten.

segments.src: In most states, insurers can base approval or pricing on your health history once your guaranteed-issue window has passed.
segments.tr: In den meisten Staaten können Versicherer die Genehmigung oder Preisgestaltung von Ihrer Gesundheitshistorie abhängig machen, sobald Ihr garantierter Ausstellungsfenster (Guaranteed-Issue-Window) abgelaufen ist.

segments.src: Rules differ by state, so check yours before dropping a supplement.
segments.tr: Die Regeln variieren je nach Bundesstaat. Überprüfen Sie daher Ihre, bevor Sie eine Zusatzversicherung kündigen.

segments.src: ## Already in Medicare Advantage? You Have a Second Chance
segments.tr: ## Bereits bei Medicare Advantage? Sie haben eine zweite Chance

segments.src: If you are in a Medicare Advantage plan, there is a separate Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period from January 1 to March 31.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie sich in einem Medicare Advantage-Tarif befinden, gibt es eine separate offene Einschreibephase für Medicare Advantage vom 1. Januar bis zum 31. März.

segments.src: During it, you can switch to a different Advantage plan or return to Original Medicare (and join a stand-alone Part D plan).
segments.tr: Während dieser Zeit können Sie zu einem anderen Advantage-Tarif wechseln oder zu Original Medicare zurückkehren (und einen eigenständigen Part D-Tarif abschließen).

segments.src: You cannot use it to move from Original Medicare into Advantage, and it is limited to one change.
segments.tr: Sie können sie nicht nutzen, um von Original Medicare zu Advantage zu wechseln, und sie ist auf eine Änderung beschränkt.

segments.src: It is a useful safety net, but it is better not to depend on it, since you would start the year in a plan you already suspected was a poor fit.
segments.tr: Sie ist ein nützliches Sicherheitsnetz, aber es ist besser, sich nicht darauf zu verlassen, da Sie das Jahr in einem Tarif beginnen würden, bei dem Sie bereits vermuteten, dass er schlecht passt.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Free, Unbiased Help
segments.tr: ## Wo Sie kostenlose, unvoreingenommene Hilfe erhalten

segments.src: - **Medicare Plan Finder at Medicare.gov** lets you enter your drugs, pharmacies and ZIP code to compare plans side by side.
segments.tr: - **Der Medicare Plan Finder auf Medicare.gov** ermöglicht es Ihnen, Ihre Medikamente, Apotheken und Postleitzahl einzugeben, um Tarife direkt miteinander zu vergleichen.

segments.src: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** connects you with Medicare directly, 24 hours a day.
segments.tr: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** verbindet Sie rund um die Uhr direkt mit Medicare.

segments.src: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIP)** offer free, one-on-one counseling from trained local counselors who do not sell insurance. Find yours at shiphelp.org.
segments.tr: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIP)** bieten kostenlose Einzelberatungen von geschulten lokalen Beratern an, die keine Versicherungen verkaufen. Finden Sie Ihren unter shiphelp.org.

segments.src: - **Your "Medicare & You" handbook** summarizes options and rules for the coming year.
segments.tr: - **Ihr "Medicare & You"-Handbuch** fasst Optionen und Regeln für das kommende Jahr zusammen.

segments.src: If you work with an insurance agent or broker, remember that they may be paid by certain plans.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie mit einem Versicherungsagenten oder Makler zusammenarbeiten, denken Sie daran, dass diese möglicherweise von bestimmten Tarifen bezahlt werden.

segments.src: Ask which plans they do and do not represent, and consider verifying your options in the Plan Finder as well.
segments.tr: Fragen Sie, welche Tarife sie vertreten und welche nicht, und erwägen Sie, Ihre Optionen auch im Plan Finder zu überprüfen.

segments.src: Be cautious about unsolicited phone calls, texts or door-to-door visits offering Medicare plans, and never share your Medicare number with someone you did not contact yourself.
segments.tr: Seien Sie vorsichtig bei unerwünschten Anrufen, Textnachrichten oder Haustürbesuchen, die Medicare-Tarife anbieten, und geben Sie niemals Ihre Medicare-Nummer an jemanden weiter, den Sie nicht selbst kontaktiert haben.

segments.src: ## A Simple Checklist
segments.tr: ## Eine einfache Checkliste

segments.src: 1. Read your Annual Notice of Change.
segments.tr: 1. Lesen Sie Ihre jährliche Änderungsmitteilung.

segments.src: 2. List every medication, dose and pharmacy, and test them in the Plan Finder.
segments.tr: 2. Listen Sie jedes Medikament, jede Dosis und Apotheke auf und testen Sie sie im Plan Finder.

segments.src: 3. Confirm your doctors and hospitals are in-network for 2027.
segments.tr: 3. Bestätigen Sie, dass Ihre Ärzte und Krankenhäuser für 2027 im Netzwerk sind.

segments.src: 4. Compare total expected costs, not just premiums.
segments.tr: 4. Vergleichen Sie die voraussichtlichen Gesamtkosten, nicht nur die Prämien.

segments.src: 5. Check star ratings and the details of extra benefits.
segments.tr: 5. Überprüfen Sie die Sternebewertungen und die Details der Zusatzleistungen.

segments.src: 6. If leaving Original Medicare, understand your Medigap rights first.
segments.tr: 6. Wenn Sie Original Medicare verlassen, verstehen Sie zuerst Ihre Medigap-Rechte.

segments.src: 7. Make your choice before **December 7**, and confirm it in writing once you enroll.
segments.tr: 7. Treffen Sie Ihre Wahl vor dem **7. Dezember** und bestätigen Sie diese nach der Anmeldung schriftlich.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: Open enrollment is a short window, and the choices you make carry through the whole year.
segments.tr: Die offene Einschreibung ist ein kurzes Zeitfenster, und Ihre Entscheidungen gelten für das ganze Jahr.

segments.src: Spending an hour comparing options now can help you avoid unexpected bills and gaps in coverage in 2027.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie eine Stunde damit verbringen, Optionen zu vergleichen, können Sie unerwartete Rechnungen und Lücken im Versicherungsschutz im Jahr 2027 vermeiden.

segments.src: Whether you decide to keep your current plan or change it, make it a deliberate choice rather than a default.
segments.tr: Unabhängig davon, ob Sie Ihren aktuellen Tarif behalten oder ihn wechseln möchten, treffen Sie eine bewusste Entscheidung statt einer Standardlösung.

segments.src: *Plan details, benefit amounts and deadlines can change.
segments.tr: *Tarifdetails, Leistungsbeträge und Fristen können sich ändern.

segments.src: Always confirm current information with Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE before making enrollment decisions.*
segments.tr: Bestätigen Sie aktuelle Informationen immer auf Medicare.gov oder unter 1-800-MEDICARE, bevor Sie Entscheidungen zur Einschreibung treffen.*

vi.title: Thời Gian Đăng Ký Mở Medicare Kết Thúc Vào Ngày 7 Tháng 12: Những Điều Cần Kiểm Tra Trước Khi Gia Hạn Cho Năm 2027

segments.src: Medicare's annual open enrollment period runs from October 15 to December 7.
segments.tr: Thời gian đăng ký mở hàng năm của Medicare kéo dài từ ngày 15 tháng 10 đến ngày 7 tháng 12.

segments.src: During these weeks, people with Medicare can review their coverage and make changes that take effect on January 1, 2027.
segments.tr: Trong những tuần này, những người tham gia Medicare có thể xem lại phạm vi bảo hiểm của họ và thực hiện các thay đổi có hiệu lực vào ngày 1 tháng 1, 2027.

segments.src: Because plans adjust their costs, drug lists and provider networks every year, a plan that worked well in 2026 may not be the best fit next year.
segments.tr: Vì các chương trình điều chỉnh chi phí, danh mục thuốc và mạng lưới nhà cung cấp mỗi năm, một chương trình hoạt động tốt vào năm 2026 có thể không phải là lựa chọn phù hợp nhất vào năm tới.

segments.src: This article is general information, not personal financial, medical or insurance advice.
segments.tr: Bài viết này mang thông tin chung, không phải lời khuyên tài chính, y tế hoặc bảo hiểm cá nhân.

segments.src: Your own situation, location and plan options will determine what makes sense for you.
segments.tr: Hoàn cảnh, địa điểm và các lựa chọn chương trình của riêng bạn sẽ quyết định điều gì phù hợp với bạn.

segments.src: ## What You Can Change During Open Enrollment
segments.tr: ## Những Gì Bạn Có Thể Thay Đổi Trong Thời Gian Đăng Ký Mở

segments.src: Between October 15 and December 7, people with Medicare can generally:
segments.tr: Từ ngày 15 tháng 10 đến ngày 7 tháng 12, những người tham gia Medicare thường có thể:

segments.src: - **Switch from Original Medicare to a Medicare Advantage plan (Part C)**, or the reverse.
segments.tr: - **Chuyển từ Medicare Gốc sang chương trình Medicare Advantage (Phần C)**, hoặc ngược lại.

segments.src: - **Switch from one Medicare Advantage plan to another.**
segments.tr: - **Chuyển từ chương trình Medicare Advantage này sang chương trình khác.**

segments.src: - **Join, drop or change a Medicare Part D prescription drug plan.**
segments.tr: - **Tham gia, hủy hoặc thay đổi chương trình thuốc theo toa Medicare Phần D.**

segments.src: If you are happy with your current coverage and it is not changing in ways that matter to you, you do not need to do anything.
segments.tr: Nếu bạn hài lòng với phạm vi bảo hiểm hiện tại của mình và nó không thay đổi theo những cách quan trọng đối với bạn, bạn không cần phải làm gì cả.

segments.src: Most plans renew automatically.
segments.tr: Hầu hết các chương trình tự động gia hạn.

segments.src: However, automatic renewal also means you accept next year's costs and rules, which is why a review is worthwhile.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, việc tự động gia hạn cũng có nghĩa là bạn chấp nhận chi phí và quy tắc của năm tới, đó là lý do tại sao việc xem lại rất đáng giá.

segments.src: ## Start With Your Annual Notice of Change
segments.tr: ## Bắt Đầu Với Thông Báo Thay Đổi Hàng Năm Của Bạn

segments.src: Medicare Advantage and Part D plans are required to send current members an Annual Notice of Change (ANOC) by the end of September.
segments.tr: Các chương trình Medicare Advantage và Phần D bắt buộc phải gửi Thông Báo Thay Đổi Hàng Năm (ANOC) cho các thành viên hiện tại trước cuối tháng 9.

segments.src: Pull it out and read it carefully.
segments.tr: Hãy lấy ra và đọc kỹ.

segments.src: It explains what will be different in 2027, including:
segments.tr: Nó giải thích những gì sẽ khác biệt vào năm 2027, bao gồm:

segments.src: - Monthly premiums and deductibles
segments.tr: - Phí bảo hiểm hàng tháng và khoản khấu trừ

segments.src: - Copayments and coinsurance for doctor visits, hospital stays and specialists
segments.tr: - Khoản đồng chi trả và đồng bảo hiểm cho các chuyến thăm khám bác sĩ, nằm viện và bác sĩ chuyên khoa

segments.src: - Changes to the list of covered drugs, known as the formulary
segments.tr: - Thay đổi danh mục thuốc được chi trả, được gọi là formulary

segments.src: - Changes to the pharmacies and providers in the plan's network
segments.tr: - Thay đổi các hiệu thuốc và nhà cung cấp trong mạng lưới của chương trình

segments.src: - Changes to extra benefits such as dental, vision or hearing
segments.tr: - Thay đổi các quyền lợi bổ sung như nha khoa, thị giác hoặc thính giác

segments.src: Many people never open this notice.
segments.tr: Nhiều người không bao giờ mở thông báo này.

segments.src: Reading it is often the quickest way to find out whether your plan is moving in a direction that no longer suits you.
segments.tr: Đọc nó thường là cách nhanh nhất để tìm hiểu xem chương trình của bạn có đang di chuyển theo hướng không còn phù hợp với bạn hay không.

segments.src: ## Six Things to Check Before the Deadline
segments.tr: ## Sáu Điều Cần Kiểm Tra Trước Thời Hạn

segments.src: ### 1. Your prescription drugs
segments.tr: ### 1. Thuốc theo toa của bạn

segments.src: Drug coverage is where plan changes most often cause surprises.
segments.tr: Phạm vi bảo hiểm thuốc là nơi các thay đổi chương trình thường gây ra bất ngờ nhất.

segments.src: For each medication you take, confirm:
segments.tr: Đối với mỗi loại thuốc bạn dùng, hãy xác nhận:

segments.src: - Whether it is still on the plan's formulary
segments.tr: - Liệu nó có còn trong danh mục thuốc của chương trình hay không

segments.src: - Which cost tier it falls into, since tiers drive your copay
segments.tr: - Nó thuộc bậc chi phí nào, vì các bậc quyết định khoản đồng chi trả của bạn

segments.src: - Whether new restrictions, such as prior authorization or step therapy, now apply
segments.tr: - Liệu các hạn chế mới, chẳng hạn như sự ủy quyền trước hoặc liệu pháp từng bước, có được áp dụng hay không

segments.src: - Whether your pharmacy is still in the network, and whether it is a "preferred" pharmacy with lower costs
segments.tr: - Liệu hiệu thuốc của bạn có còn trong mạng lưới hay không, và đó có phải là hiệu thuốc "ưa thích" với chi phí thấp hơn hay không

segments.src: Part D also includes an annual cap on what you pay out of pocket for covered drugs, a feature added by recent federal law.
segments.tr: Phần D cũng bao gồm mức trần hàng năm cho số tiền bạn trả ngoài túi cho các loại thuốc được chi trả, một tính năng được bổ sung bởi luật liên bang gần đây.

segments.src: The cap amount is set and adjusted by the government each year, so check the current figure at Medicare.gov rather than relying on last year's number.
segments.tr: Số tiền trần được thiết lập và điều chỉnh bởi chính phủ mỗi năm, vì vậy hãy kiểm tra số liệu hiện tại tại Medicare.gov thay vì dựa vào con số của năm ngoái.

segments.src: ### 2. Your doctors, hospitals and specialists
segments.tr: ### 2. Bác sĩ, bệnh viện và chuyên gia của bạn

segments.src: Original Medicare lets you see any provider who accepts Medicare, nationwide.
segments.tr: Medicare Gốc cho phép bạn gặp bất kỳ nhà cung cấp nào chấp nhận Medicare, trên toàn quốc.

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans generally use networks, and some require referrals or prior authorization for certain services.
segments.tr: Các chương trình Medicare Advantage thường sử dụng mạng lưới, và một số yêu cầu giấy giới thiệu hoặc sự ủy quyền trước cho các dịch vụ nhất định.

segments.src: Before you renew or switch, look up each of your doctors and any hospital you rely on, and confirm with the provider's office that they will be in the plan's network in 2027.
segments.tr: Trước khi bạn gia hạn hoặc chuyển đổi, hãy tra cứu từng bác sĩ của bạn và bất kỳ bệnh viện nào bạn dựa vào, đồng thời xác nhận với văn phòng của nhà cung cấp rằng họ sẽ có mặt trong mạng lưới của chương trình vào năm 2027.

segments.src: Networks can change during the year, so asking the office directly is a good safeguard.
segments.tr: Mạng lưới có thể thay đổi trong năm, vì vậy việc hỏi trực tiếp văn phòng là một biện pháp bảo vệ tốt.

segments.src: ### 3. The full cost, not just the premium
segments.tr: ### 3. Tổng chi phí, không chỉ phí bảo hiểm

segments.src: A low or $0 premium does not tell you what you will actually spend.
segments.tr: Phí bảo hiểm thấp hoặc $0 không cho bạn biết số tiền bạn thực sự sẽ chi tiêu.

segments.src: Compare:
segments.tr: So sánh:

segments.src: - Monthly premium (and your Part B premium, which most people still pay)
segments.tr: - Phí bảo hiểm hàng tháng (và phí bảo hiểm Phần B của bạn, mà hầu hết mọi người vẫn trả)

segments.src: - Annual deductible
segments.tr: - Khoản khấu trừ hàng năm

segments.src: - Copays and coinsurance for services you use often
segments.tr: - Khoản đồng chi trả và đồng bảo hiểm cho các dịch vụ bạn thường xuyên sử dụng

segments.src: - The plan's maximum out-of-pocket limit for medical services
segments.tr: - Giới hạn chi trả ngoài túi tối đa của chương trình cho các dịch vụ y tế

segments.src: - Costs for hospital stays, emergency care and skilled nursing
segments.tr: - Chi phí cho việc nằm viện, chăm sóc cấp cứu và điều dưỡng chuyên nghiệp

segments.src: Think about both a typical year and a bad year.
segments.tr: Hãy suy nghĩ về cả một năm điển hình và một năm tồi tệ.

segments.src: A plan with lower premiums but higher cost sharing can cost more if you have a health event.
segments.tr: Một chương trình có phí bảo hiểm thấp hơn nhưng chia sẻ chi phí cao hơn có thể tốn kém hơn nếu bạn gặp sự cố sức khỏe.

segments.src: ### 4. Plan quality ratings
segments.tr: ### 4. Xếp hạng chất lượng chương trình

segments.src: Medicare rates Advantage and Part D plans on a 5-star scale based on member satisfaction and quality of care.
segments.tr: Medicare xếp hạng các chương trình Advantage và Phần D trên thang đo 5 sao dựa trên sự hài lòng của thành viên và chất lượng chăm sóc.

segments.src: Ratings are posted in the Medicare Plan Finder.
segments.tr: Xếp hạng được đăng trong Trình Tìm Kiếm Chương Trình Medicare.

segments.src: They are not the only factor, but a plan with consistently low ratings deserves a closer look.
segments.tr: Chúng không phải là yếu tố duy nhất, nhưng một chương trình có xếp hạng thấp liên tục xứng đáng được xem xét kỹ hơn.

segments.src: ### 5. Extra benefits, and how they really work
segments.tr: ### 5. Quyền lợi bổ sung và cách chúng thực sự hoạt động

segments.src: Medicare Advantage plans often advertise extras such as dental, vision, hearing aids, fitness programs, over-the-counter allowances or transportation.
segments.tr: Các chương trình Medicare Advantage thường quảng cáo các tiện ích bổ sung như nha khoa, thị giác, máy trợ thính, chương trình thể dục, trợ cấp mua thuốc không cần kê đơn hoặc phương tiện đi lại.

segments.src: Read the details: benefits may have dollar caps, limited provider lists, or waiting periods.
segments.tr: Đọc chi tiết: các quyền lợi có thể có mức trần đô la, danh sách nhà cung cấp hạn chế hoặc thời gian chờ đợi.

segments.src: Compare them against what you would realistically use.
segments.tr: So sánh chúng với những gì bạn thực tế sẽ sử dụng.

segments.src: ### 6. Your ability to switch back later
segments.tr: ### 6. Khả năng chuyển đổi trở lại sau đó

segments.src: This point matters if you are considering leaving Original Medicare.
segments.tr: Điểm này quan trọng nếu bạn đang cân nhắc rời khỏi Medicare Gốc.

segments.src: If you buy a Medigap (Medicare Supplement) policy to cover Original Medicare's cost sharing, and later move to Medicare Advantage, you may not be able to get a Medigap policy again without answering health questions.
segments.tr: Nếu bạn mua chính sách Medigap (Bổ Sung Medicare) để chi trả phần chia sẻ chi phí của Medicare Gốc, và sau đó chuyển sang Medicare Advantage, bạn có thể không thể mua lại chính sách Medigap mà không trả lời các câu hỏi về sức khỏe.

segments.src: In most states, insurers can base approval or pricing on your health history once your guaranteed-issue window has passed.
segments.tr: Ở hầu hết các tiểu bang, các công ty bảo hiểm có thể dựa vào lịch sử sức khỏe của bạn để phê duyệt hoặc định giá một khi thời hạn phát hành đảm bảo của bạn đã trôi qua.

segments.src: Rules differ by state, so check yours before dropping a supplement.
segments.tr: Các quy tắc khác nhau tùy theo tiểu bang, vì vậy hãy kiểm tra quy tắc của bạn trước khi bỏ phần bổ sung.

segments.src: ## Already in Medicare Advantage? You Have a Second Chance
segments.tr: ## Đã Tham Gia Medicare Advantage? Bạn Có Cơ Hội Thứ Hai

segments.src: If you are in a Medicare Advantage plan, there is a separate Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period from January 1 to March 31.
segments.tr: Nếu bạn đang tham gia chương trình Medicare Advantage, có Thời Gian Đăng Ký Mở Medicare Advantage riêng từ ngày 1 tháng 1 đến ngày 31 tháng 3.

segments.src: During it, you can switch to a different Advantage plan or return to Original Medicare (and join a stand-alone Part D plan).
segments.tr: Trong thời gian này, bạn có thể chuyển sang chương trình Advantage khác hoặc quay lại Medicare Gốc (và tham gia chương trình Phần D độc lập).

segments.src: You cannot use it to move from Original Medicare into Advantage, and it is limited to one change.
segments.tr: Bạn không thể sử dụng nó để chuyển từ Medicare Gốc sang Advantage, và nó chỉ giới hạn ở một lần thay đổi.

segments.src: It is a useful safety net, but it is better not to depend on it, since you would start the year in a plan you already suspected was a poor fit.
segments.tr: Đó là một lưới an toàn hữu ích, nhưng tốt hơn là không nên phụ thuộc vào nó, vì bạn sẽ bắt đầu năm trong một chương trình mà bạn đã nghi ngờ là không phù hợp.

segments.src: ## Where to Get Free, Unbiased Help
segments.tr: ## Nơi Nhận Trợ Giúp Miễn Phí, Khách Quan

segments.src: - **Medicare Plan Finder at Medicare.gov** lets you enter your drugs, pharmacies and ZIP code to compare plans side by side.
segments.tr: - **Trình Tìm Kiếm Chương Trình Medicare tại Medicare.gov** cho phép bạn nhập thuốc, hiệu thuốc và mã ZIP để so sánh các chương trình cạnh nhau.

segments.src: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** connects you with Medicare directly, 24 hours a day.
segments.tr: - **1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)** kết nối bạn trực tiếp với Medicare, 24 giờ một ngày.

segments.src: - **State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIP)** offer free, one-on-one counseling from trained local counselors who do not sell insurance. Find yours at shiphelp.org.
segments.tr: - **Chương Trình Hỗ Trợ Bảo Hiểm Y Tế Tiểu Bang (SHIP)** cung cấp tư vấn miễn phí, một đối một từ các cố vấn địa phương được đào tạo, những người không bán bảo hiểm. Tìm chương trình của bạn tại shiphelp.org.

segments.src: - **Your "Medicare & You" handbook** summarizes options and rules for the coming year.
segments.tr: - **Cẩm nang "Medicare & You" của bạn** tóm tắt các tùy chọn và quy tắc cho năm tới.

segments.src: If you work with an insurance agent or broker, remember that they may be paid by certain plans.
segments.tr: Nếu bạn làm việc với một đại lý hoặc môi giới bảo hiểm, hãy nhớ rằng họ có thể được trả tiền bởi các chương trình nhất định.

segments.src: Ask which plans they do and do not represent, and consider verifying your options in the Plan Finder as well.
segments.tr: Hãy hỏi chương trình nào họ đại diện và không đại diện, đồng thời cân nhắc xác minh các tùy chọn của bạn trong Trình Tìm Kiếm Chương Trình.

segments.src: Be cautious about unsolicited phone calls, texts or door-to-door visits offering Medicare plans, and never share your Medicare number with someone you did not contact yourself.
segments.tr: Hãy thận trọng với các cuộc gọi điện thoại, tin nhắn hoặc chuyến thăm tận nhà không được yêu cầu cung cấp các chương trình Medicare, và không bao giờ chia sẻ số Medicare của bạn với người mà bạn không tự liên hệ.

segments.src: ## A Simple Checklist
segments.tr: ## Danh Sách Kiểm Tra Đơn Giản

segments.src: 1. Read your Annual Notice of Change.
segments.tr: 1. Đọc Thông Báo Thay Đổi Hàng Năm của bạn.

segments.src: 2. List every medication, dose and pharmacy, and test them in the Plan Finder.
segments.tr: 2. Liệt kê mọi loại thuốc, liều lượng và hiệu thuốc, và kiểm tra chúng trong Trình Tìm Kiếm Chương Trình.

segments.src: 3. Confirm your doctors and hospitals are in-network for 2027.
segments.tr: 3. Xác nhận các bác sĩ và bệnh viện của bạn nằm trong mạng lưới cho năm 2027.

segments.src: 4. Compare total expected costs, not just premiums.
segments.tr: 4. So sánh tổng chi phí dự kiến, không chỉ phí bảo hiểm.

segments.src: 5. Check star ratings and the details of extra benefits.
segments.tr: 5. Kiểm tra xếp hạng sao và chi tiết về các quyền lợi bổ sung.

segments.src: 6. If leaving Original Medicare, understand your Medigap rights first.
segments.tr: 6. Nếu rời khỏi Medicare Gốc, hãy hiểu các quyền Medigap của bạn trước.

segments.src: 7. Make your choice before **December 7**, and confirm it in writing once you enroll.
segments.tr: 7. Đưa ra lựa chọn của bạn trước **ngày 7 tháng 12**, và xác nhận nó bằng văn bản sau khi bạn đăng ký.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm Mấu Chốt

segments.src: Open enrollment is a short window, and the choices you make carry through the whole year.
segments.tr: Đăng ký mở là một khoảng thời gian ngắn, và các lựa chọn bạn đưa ra sẽ kéo dài suốt cả năm.

segments.src: Spending an hour comparing options now can help you avoid unexpected bills and gaps in coverage in 2027.
segments.tr: Dành một giờ để so sánh các tùy chọn ngay bây giờ có thể giúp bạn tránh các hóa đơn bất ngờ và khoảng trống trong phạm vi bảo hiểm vào năm 2027.

segments.src: Whether you decide to keep your current plan or change it, make it a deliberate choice rather than a default.
segments.tr: Cho dù bạn quyết định giữ nguyên chương trình hiện tại hay thay đổi nó, hãy biến nó thành một lựa chọn có chủ ý thay vì mặc định.

segments.src: *Plan details, benefit amounts and deadlines can change.
segments.tr: *Chi tiết chương trình, số tiền quyền lợi và thời hạn có thể thay đổi.

segments.src: Always confirm current information with Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE before making enrollment decisions.*
segments.tr: Luôn xác nhận thông tin hiện tại với Medicare.gov hoặc 1-800-MEDICARE trước khi đưa ra quyết định đăng ký.*
